items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI砸錢何時回本？Alphabet財報失色、通膨又施壓 主要指數開低
paras: 美股周四(29日)開盤走低，Alphabet與開拓重工財報未能滿足市場期待，再度引發投資人對人工智慧(AI)龐大支出與投資回報的疑慮，科技股承壓，標普500指數面臨終結連三日漲勢的壓力。
聯準會(Fed)前一日維持利率不變後，最新公布的美國9月PCE通膨年增率升至3.6%，市場同步評估物價壓力對年底利率走向的影響。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌逾200點或近0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近480點或近1.8%，標普 500 指數跌近0.6%，費城半導體指數跌近2.3%，台積電ADR跌近1.4%。
全球科技股漲勢受挫，Alphabet與三星電子財報表現不如預期，再度引發市場對人工智慧(AI)龐大投資能否帶來足夠回報的疑慮。周四美股盤前，那斯達克100指數期貨下跌1.3%，預示指數可能終結連三日漲勢；標普500指數期貨下跌0.5%，美國第三季經濟成長優於預期，也未能扭轉跌勢。
美債則在聯準會(Fed)周三維持利率不變後持穩，2年期美債殖利率徘徊於4.7%，10年期約5%。市場接下來關注歐洲央行與日本央行決策，兩者均料按兵不動。

AI支出回報受檢驗 科技與設備股承壓

Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)盤前重挫11%，營收不如預期，令投資人擔憂，即使投入數千億美元發展AI，仍難阻止競爭對手侵蝕核心業務。三星電子(005930-KR)則下跌4.1%，晶片部門獲利未達預期、資本支出增加，加上未推出新的股東回饋計畫，令市場失望。
Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston表示，市場並非質疑Alphabet的AI機會，而是在建設成本持續壓抑現金流之際，重新衡量應給予多少價值；投資人對支出、利潤率與現金創造能力不如預期的容忍度正降低。
微軟(MSFT-US)原因雲端銷售強勁而盤前上漲3.7%，但啟動2017年以來首筆投資等級債券發行後，回吐大部分漲幅。ServiceNow(NOW-US)與Fortinet(FTNT-US)財報失色，也加深軟體業前景疑慮，後者暴跌27%。
AI資料中心電力設備供應商開拓重工(CAT-US)預估第四季營收僅溫和成長，股價重挫10%。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周四盤後及蘋果(AAPL-US)下周公布的財報，將進一步考驗市場信心。

歐股走揚油價回落 通膨數據牽動美債

歐洲Stoxx600指數上漲0.6%，能源與電信股漲勢抵銷銀行股下跌。殼牌(SHEL-US)宣布大幅增加庫藏股規模後走高，荷蘭國際集團(ING-US)則因獲利不如預期、成本與呆帳準備增加而下跌，並宣布裁減約400人。
油價隨中東外交斡旋進展回落，市場評估相關努力能否避免美國恢復對伊朗軍事打擊，布蘭特原油下跌1%至每桶114.10美元。
Fed周三以10比2維持利率不變後，投資人也關注美國核心個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數。《彭博》策略師Ven Ram指出，2年期美債殖利率過去一個月已下降約25個基點，若通膨高於預期，顯示Fed抑制物價仍有漫長道路，可能引發短天期美債獲利了結賣壓。

items.title: 歐洲央行利率按兵不動 聚焦能源通膨與拉加德繼任人選
items.title_en: ECB Holds Rates Steady, Focus Shifts to Energy Inflation and Lagarde Successor
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)宣布維持關鍵基準利率不變，存款利率維持在2.50%、主要再融資利率為2.65%、邊際貸款利率則為2.90%，決策完全符合市場預期。
與此同時，美國聯準會(Fed)本周維持利率按兵不動，日本央行則預期於周五跟進維持利率政策。
然而，總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)突襲宣布將於明年2月提前卸任，較原定任期提早數月，為本次決策會議拋下震撼彈。拉加德表示，提前離任旨在獲得更多自由，以便對包括法國政治與財政動盪在內的各項議題發聲。
此一重大人事異動不僅遮蔽了利率決策焦點，更提前引發西班牙與荷蘭前央行總裁角逐繼任寶座的競爭。
在宏觀經濟層面，受伊朗戰爭衝擊影響，全球能源價格再度攀升，自上次會議以來原油價格已上漲逾6%，天然氣價格更創下近4年新高。能源價格飆升推升歐元區9月消費者物價指數(CPI)達3.8%，官員憂心通膨恐朝向2%目標的兩倍攀升。
雖然核心通膨與薪資反應目前維持平穩，但高能源成本與金融條件緊縮正持續壓抑需求，預估第三季經濟成長放緩至0.2%，銀行端因風險疑慮而持續收緊放款標準。
歐洲央行強調，未來貨幣政策將持續採取「依賴數據、逐次會議評估」的機制。市場普遍預期央行將於12月再度升息，部分分析師認為這將是本輪循環的最後一次升息，然而受能源成本隱憂影響，也有投資人押注2027年仍有進一步升息的空間。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) announced that it will keep its key policy rates unchanged, with the deposit rate at 2.50%, the main refinancing rate at 2.65%, and the marginal lending rate at 2.90%, a decision fully in line with market expectations.
At the same time, the U.S. Federal Reserve is also holding rates steady this week, while the Bank of Japan is expected to follow suit on Friday and maintain its rate policy.

However, President Christine Lagarde unexpectedly announced that she will step down in February next year, several months earlier than her scheduled term, delivering a shock to the policy meeting. Lagarde said the early departure is meant to give her more freedom to speak on a range of issues, including France’s political and fiscal turmoil.
This major personnel change not only obscured the focus on rate decisions but also accelerated the competition between former central bank heads of Spain and the Netherlands to succeed her.

On the macro side, the global energy market has been hit by the Iran war, pushing oil prices up more than 6% since the last meeting and natural gas to a near‑four‑year high. The surge in energy prices lifted the euro‑area September consumer price index (CPI) to 3.8%, prompting officials to worry that inflation could rise to twice the 2% target.

Although core inflation and wage dynamics remain stable, high energy costs and tighter financial conditions continue to suppress demand, with Q3 growth now projected to slow to 0.2% and banks tightening lending standards over risk concerns.

The ECB stressed that future monetary policy will continue to follow a “data‑dependent, meeting‑by‑meeting” approach. Markets broadly expect another rate hike in December, with some analysts seeing it as the final increase of this cycle, while concerns over energy costs have led some investors to bet on further hikes as late as 2027.

items.title: 〈瑞昱法說〉Q4淡季不淡、Wi-Fi 8明年下半年放量 2030年HPC及邊緣AI營收占比拚3成
items.title_en: Realtek Earnings Call: Q4 Not Slow Despite Seasonality, Wi‑Fi 8 to Ramp Up in H2 2027, Aim for >30% HPC and Edge AI Revenue Share by 2030
paras: 網通晶片廠瑞昱(2379-TW)今(29)日舉行法說會，瑞昱表示，受惠高規格產品組合及價格調整帶動平均售價(ASP)提升，第四季營運有望淡季不淡，即使PC需求進一步走弱，營收仍可能避免往常的季節性放緩。展望2027年，公司預期營收將穩健成長，並持續布局Wi-Fi 8、車載乙太網路、高速傳輸及邊緣AI等應用，其中Wi-Fi 8解決方案預計明年下半年開始放量。
針對第四季營運展望，瑞昱指出，整體營運動能目前維持穩定，較佳的產品組合及價格調整帶動平均售價提升，將有助抵銷部分PC需求走弱的影響。不過，晶圓代工與封測成本持續上漲，以及供應鏈產能分配仍是重要外部變數，公司將持續與供應鏈夥伴及客戶協調，並採取審慎的定價策略。
展望2027年，瑞昱維持營收穩健成長的看法，主要動能來自平均售價提升、產品規格升級及新產品推出。公司也將在維持毛利率穩定的前提下，兼顧營收成長、市占率與獲利能力。
在無線連網技術方面，瑞昱表示，Wi-Fi 7在個人電腦與路由器市場的滲透率預計今年達約30%，2027年可望進一步提升至約40%。至於次世代Wi-Fi 8，公司持續參與前期測試及規格制定，認證測試計畫目標於2027年6月完成，官方認證預計同年9月啟動，旗下解決方案則將於2027年下半年開始放量，2028年客戶採用可望更加廣泛。
車載與實體AI方面，瑞昱指出，車載乙太網路在全球新車市場的滲透率已突破50%。儘管整體汽車出貨量大致持平，但隨著車廠轉向區域控制架構，每車乙太網路連接埠數增加，有助推升單車晶片價值。瑞昱持續拓展車用乙太網路交換器及閘道控制器產品，並已獲全球車廠及一線供應商設計導入。
機器人方面，由於內部連網技術與車載應用具有高度相容性，瑞昱連網解決方案已導入第一波主要商用機器人，並與全球領先的人形機器人開發商合作，供應原型機及早期導入專案，持續布局實體AI應用。
在高速傳輸與雲端運算方面，瑞昱表示，多千兆乙太網路解決方案占整體乙太網路營收比重已超過40%。隨著本地端大型語言模型(LLM)運算需求增加，終端電腦也持續升級至5G、10G乙太網路規格。光通訊方面，100G光學實體層(PHY)晶片正進行客戶認證，預期2027年放量將更為顯著；400G與800G PAM4數位訊號處理器(DSP)則按計畫開發，預計2027年下半年推出。
瑞昱進一步指出，目前高效能運算(HPC)與邊緣AI相關業務占總營收比重為高個位數百分比，涵蓋車用、機器人及相關運算應用。公司設定中長期目標，預計至2030年將高效能運算與邊緣AI營收占比提升至30%以上，並持續拓展乙太網路、交換器、儲存控制器及高速互連等產品在AI伺服器與基礎設施的應用。
paras_en: Realtek (2379‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (29th). The company said that thanks to a high‑spec product mix and price adjustments that lifted average selling price (ASP), Q4 operations are expected to avoid the usual seasonal slowdown. Even if PC demand weakens further, revenue may still dodge the typical seasonal dip. Looking ahead to 2027, the firm expects steady revenue growth and continues to invest in Wi‑Fi 8, automotive Ethernet, high‑speed transport and edge AI applications, with Wi‑Fi 8 solutions slated to scale from the second half of next year.

Regarding the Q4 outlook, Realtek noted that overall operating momentum remains stable. A better product mix and price adjustments that raise ASP will help offset some of the impact from weaker PC demand. However, rising wafer‑foundry and test‑pack costs, as well as supply‑chain capacity allocation, remain key external variables. The company will keep coordinating with supply‑chain partners and customers and will adopt a prudent pricing strategy.

Looking to 2027, Realtek maintains its view of steady revenue growth, driven mainly by higher ASPs, upgraded product specifications and new product launches. The firm will aim to keep gross margins stable while balancing revenue growth, market share and profitability.

In wireless networking, Realtek said Wi‑Fi 7 penetration in PCs and routers is expected to reach about 30% this year and roughly 40% by 2027. For next‑generation Wi‑Fi 8, the company continues early‑stage testing and specification work, targeting certification test completion by June 2027, official certification in September 2027, and volume production of its solutions starting in the second half of 2027, with broader customer adoption anticipated in 2028.

On automotive and physical AI, Realtek noted that automotive Ethernet penetration in the global new‑car market has already exceeded 50%. Although overall vehicle shipments are roughly flat, automakers are shifting to zone‑control architectures, increasing the number of Ethernet ports per vehicle and boosting per‑car chip value. Realtek is expanding its automotive Ethernet switch and gateway controller portfolio and has secured design adoption from global OEMs and tier‑1 suppliers.

Regarding robotics, because its internal networking technology is highly compatible with automotive applications, Realtek’s networking solutions have been incorporated into the first wave of major commercial robots. The company is also working with leading humanoid robot developers to supply prototype units and early‑stage deployment projects, further building out physical‑AI use cases.

In high‑speed transport and cloud computing, Realtek said multi‑gigabit Ethernet solutions now account for over 40% of total Ethernet revenue. As demand for on‑premise large language model (LLM) processing grows, end‑point devices are upgrading to 5G and 10G Ethernet specs. In optics, its 100G optical PHY chip is undergoing customer qualification, with volume expected to rise sharply in 2027; 400G and 800G PAM4 digital signal processors are on schedule, slated for release in the second half of 2027.

Realtek added that today its high‑performance computing (HPC) and edge‑AI businesses represent a high‑single‑digit percentage of total revenue, covering automotive, robotics and related compute applications. The company has set a mid‑to‑long‑term goal to lift the share of HPC and edge‑AI revenue to over 30% by 2030, while continuing to expand Ethernet, switch, storage controller and high‑speed interconnect products for AI servers and infrastructure.

items.title: 〈財報〉業績超標股價卻崩了！開拓重工盤前跌逾10% 市場在怕什麼？
items.title_en: Earnings Beat Yet Stock Crashes: Caterpillar Falls Over 10% Pre‑Market, What’s the Market Worried About?
paras: 有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的開拓重工(CAT-US)周四(29日)美股盤前公布2026會計年度第三季(截至9月30日)財報，營收與調整後每股純益均優於市場預期，未交付訂單也創新高，但公司維持全年營收成長展望，未能化解投資人對人工智慧(AI)基礎建設熱潮能否延續的疑慮，股價盤前一度重挫逾10%。
根據財報，開拓重工第三季營收年增17%至206.8億美元，高於LSEG調查預估的205.5億美元；調整後每股純益由去年同期4.95美元升至7.20美元，優於預估的7.08美元。營業利益率達20.6%，較去年同期提高約3個百分點，也高於市場預期。
截稿前，開拓重工(CAT-US)周四盤前股價下跌9.59%，每股暫報645.00美元。

訂單創高仍難過關 全年展望未上修成焦點

開拓重工第三季未交付訂單總額達781億美元，較第二季增加60億美元，年增382億美元，雖創歷史新高，但增加速度較今年稍早放緩。
公司維持2026年營收成長百分之十幾中段至高段的預測，分析師則預期約18%，接近公司預測區間高端。開拓重工另預估，第四季營收較去年同期僅「溫和」成長，讓期待更強勁展望的投資人失望。
獲利超標的組成也受到檢視。第三季營業利益包含1.28億美元與《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA)關稅退還相關的利益，公司全年關稅成本預估則維持約22億美元。
Oppenheimer分析師Kristen Owen指出，儘管各事業普遍成長，這次獲利超標的品質仍讓投資人看見開拓重工的弱點，顯示市場不只看當季數字，也在檢驗後續成長力道。

能源業務成最大支柱 AI建設面臨政策與融資壓力

開拓重工以黃色挖土機、推土機與大型礦用卡車聞名，如今製造發電機、大型引擎與燃氣渦輪的動力與能源事業，已成為營收最大的業務。第三季該部門營收年增18%至89億美元，採礦與營建業務也分別成長15%及18%。
受惠資料中心用電需求，公司正推動多年擴產計畫，提高大型引擎與燃氣渦輪產能，今年稍早也調高發電設備銷售目標。不過，市場對AI投資回報的疑慮，加上利率攀升推高融資成本，已使相關供應鏈承壓。
資料中心的政治阻力也在增加。美國期中選舉前，耗電、用水及電費上漲疑慮成為競選議題，紐約州等地限制新開發案，增添建設地點與啟用時程的不確定性。
Raymond James分析師Tim Thein則指出，儘管監管與信用風險升溫，經銷商回饋仍顯示訂單需求強勁，尤其大型燃氣引擎交期仍處歷史偏長水準。
截至周三收盤，開拓重工股價已較6月高點下跌約33%。這次財報後再遭拋售，反映即使營運持續成長，市場仍期待更明確的證據，證明AI基建需求足以支撐未來業績。
paras_en: Caterpillar (CAT-US), dubbed the “canary of the economy,” released its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter results (ended September 30) in pre‑market trading on Thursday the 29th. Revenue and adjusted EPS both topped expectations and undelivered orders hit a record high, but the company kept its full‑year revenue outlook unchanged, failing to allay investors’ doubts about whether the AI infrastructure boom can be sustained, and the stock plunged more than 10% in pre‑market trading.

According to the filing, third‑quarter revenue rose 17% year‑over‑year to $20.68 billion, beating LSEG’s forecast of $20.55 billion. Adjusted earnings per share climbed from $4.95 a year ago to $7.20, ahead of the $7.08 estimate. Operating margin hit 20.6%, about three percentage points higher than a year ago and above market expectations.
Just before the article was filed, Caterpillar’s pre‑market share price was down 9.59%, reporting a temporary price of $645.00 per share.

Despite record‑high undelivered orders, the company still struggled to clear the hurdle, and its unchanged full‑year outlook became the focus. Caterpillar’s undelivered order backlog for the quarter reached $78.1 billion, up $6 billion from the prior quarter and $38.2 billion year‑over‑year, a historic high though the growth rate has slowed slightly from earlier in the year.

The firm kept its 2026 revenue growth forecast in the mid‑to‑high teens percent range, while analysts expect roughly 18%, near the top of the company’s own range. Caterpillar also warned that fourth‑quarter revenue would only grow “moderately” versus the same period last year, disappointing investors hoping for a stronger outlook.

The composition of the earnings beat also drew scrutiny. The quarter’s operating profit included a $128 million benefit related to refunds under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), and the company continues to estimate full‑year tariff costs at about $2.2 billion.

Oppenheimer analyst Kristen Owen noted that although most business segments grew, the quality of this earnings beat revealed Caterpillar’s weaknesses, showing that the market is looking beyond the headline numbers to assess future growth momentum.

Energy remains Caterpillar’s biggest pillar, while AI construction faces policy and financing pressure. Known for its yellow excavators, bulldozers and large mining trucks, the company’s power and energy segment—making generators, large engines and gas turbines—has become its largest revenue source. That segment’s revenue grew 18% year‑over‑year to $8.9 billion in the quarter, with mining and construction businesses up 15% and 18% respectively.

Benefiting from data‑center power demand, the company is pushing a multi‑year capacity‑expansion plan to boost large‑engine and gas‑turbine output and earlier this year raised its sales target for power‑generation equipment. However, market concerns over AI investment returns, coupled with rising interest rates that increase financing costs, are putting pressure on the related supply chain.

Political resistance to data‑center expansion is also rising. Ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, concerns about electricity, water usage and higher utility bills have become campaign issues, and states such as New York are restricting new developments, adding uncertainty to construction sites and project timelines.

Raymond James analyst Tim Thein pointed out that despite heightened regulatory and credit risks, dealer feedback still shows strong order demand, especially as delivery times for large gas engines remain historically long.

By Wednesday’s close, Caterpillar’s share price had fallen about 33% from its June high. The post‑earnings sell‑off underscores that even with continued operational growth, the market still wants clearer evidence that AI infrastructure demand is robust enough to support future performance.

items.title: 企業投資與消費強勁 美國第三季GDP年化成長率達3.4% 優於預期
items.title_en: Strong Corporate Investment and Consumer Spending Drive US Q3 GDP Annualized Growth to 3.4%, Beating Expectations
paras: 根據美國經濟分析局(BEA)與商務部周四(29日)發布的初估數據，美國第三季GDP經季節調整後以年率計算達 3.4%，顯著高於第二季的 2.2%，並優於彭博調查與道瓊共識預期的 3.2%，創下一年來最快經濟擴張速度。
在推動成長的動力方面，商務部報告指出，熱絡的企業投資與展現韌性的家庭支出為兩大核心主軸。受到人工智慧(AI)相關投資熱潮帶動，設備支出對 GDP 的貢獻創下 2011 年以來新高(排除疫情後復甦期)。同時，家庭消費支出年化成長率達 3.8%，高於預期的 3.4%，連續兩季保持強勁動能。
儘管經濟擴張亮眼，商務部數據顯示通膨壓力依然升溫。9 月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數月增 0.5%，創下6個月來最大增幅，年增率則為 3.6%。扣除食品與能源的核心 PCE 物價指數月增 0.3%、年增 3.1%，均符合道瓊共識預期。
報告發布的前一天，聯準會剛剛投票決定將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%的區間內。儘管通膨數據處於高位，但聯準會官員堅稱，他們有時間在做出下一步決策前，先對後續出爐的數據進行評估。
聯準會主席凱文華許(Kevin Warsh)表示：「我們即將面臨的這段時期，資訊量非常豐富。全球正在發生許多事情，我和我的同事們都非常關注這些動態。」
這份報告是下周期中選舉前最後一份關鍵經濟體檢表。整體數據展現出美國經濟的韌性與復甦動能，優於預期的表現，將進一步提振市場與政策制定者對經濟前景的信心。
paras_en: According to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and the Commerce Department’s preliminary estimates released on Thursday (the 29th), seasonally adjusted U.S. third‑quarter GDP grew at an annualized rate of 3.4%, markedly higher than the 2.2% recorded in the second quarter and above the Bloomberg survey and Dow Jones consensus forecast of 3.2%, marking the fastest expansion in a year.

In terms of growth drivers, the Commerce Department report highlighted vigorous corporate investment and resilient household spending as the two core pillars. Fueled by a wave of AI‑related investment, equipment spending’s contribution to GDP hit a post‑pandemic high not seen since 2011. At the same time, household consumption grew at an annualized 3.8%, outpacing the 3.4% forecast and maintaining strong momentum for a second consecutive quarter.

Despite the impressive expansion, the Commerce Department data showed inflationary pressure remains elevated. The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, the largest increase in six months, with an annual rise of 3.6%. The core PCE price index, which excludes food and energy, increased 0.3% month‑over‑month and 3.1% year‑over‑year, both in line with Dow Jones consensus expectations.

The day before the report’s release, the Federal Reserve had just voted to keep the target federal funds rate in the 3.75%‑4% range. Although inflation data remain high, Fed officials said they have time to assess upcoming data before making the next policy move.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said, “We are entering a period that is information‑rich. A lot is happening globally, and my colleagues and I are closely monitoring these dynamics.”

This report is the last key economic health check before the mid‑term elections next week. The overall data demonstrate the resilience and recovery momentum of the U.S. economy, outperforming expectations and likely to further boost market and policymaker confidence in the economic outlook.

items.title: 通膨又來施壓！美國9月PCE年增3.6% Fed12月升息機率逾八成
items.title_en: Inflation Returns to Pressure! US September PCE Up 3.6% YoY, Fed's December Rate Hike Odds Over 80%
paras: 美國9月通膨加速，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率升至3.6%，扣除食品與能源的核心PCE年增率也攀至3.1%，強化市場對聯準會(Fed)12月升息的預期。儘管名目消費支出持續增加，扣除物價因素後卻停滯，顯示家庭支出成長受到漲價推動，實際消費動能轉弱。
美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)周四(29日)公布，9月PCE物價指數月增0.5%，高於8月的0.3%，符合經濟學家預期；年增率則由8月的3.4%升至3.6%，為5月以來最高。汽油與其他商品價格上漲，是推升通膨的重要因素。
扣除波動較大的食品與能源後，9月核心PCE月增0.3%，符合預期；8月增幅則由原估0.2%上修至0.3%。核心PCE年增率由8月的3.0%升至3.1%，同樣符合市場預估，但仍明顯高於Fed的2%通膨目標。
價格壓力也不僅限於能源。排除住房的服務價格指標，也就是市場關注的「超級核心」PCE，年增率升至2024年12月以來最高，顯示服務業通膨仍具黏著性，增加Fed防止漲價壓力擴散的挑戰。
Fed周三維持基準利率於3.75%至4.00%，並在聲明中承認通膨「仍然偏高」。主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在記者會表示，能源及相關價格最近幾周再度上漲，Fed的任務是確保部分產業的相對價格變動，不會擴散至整體經濟，同時維持通膨預期穩定。
根據芝商所FedWatch工具，金融市場預估Fed在12月升息的機率約為83.3%。最新PCE數據雖未超出預期，但整體與核心通膨同步走高，支持經濟學家對年底再度升息的判斷。
消費方面，占美國經濟活動逾三分之二的個人消費支出，9月月增0.5%，低於市場預估的0.6%，也較8月的0.9%放緩。扣除通膨後，實質消費支出與前月持平，意味消費以較弱的成長動能邁入第四季。
同月個人所得僅增加0.2%，低於預期的0.5%，增幅也落後消費支出，個人儲蓄率因而降至2022年10月以來最低。物價上漲、所得增幅有限與儲蓄緩衝縮小，凸顯美國家庭面臨的壓力。
同日公布的第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初估顯示，美國經濟經季節調整後換算成年率成長3.4%，消費支出以相同口徑成長3.8%。不過，9月實質消費停滯，也提醒市場，第三季整體成長強勁，未必代表季末需求同樣穩健。
paras_en: US September inflation accelerated, with the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rising 3.6% year‑over‑year and the core PCE (excluding food and energy) climbing to 3.1%, bolstering market expectations of a Fed rate hike in December. Although nominal consumer spending kept rising, real spending stalled after stripping out price effects, indicating that household spending growth was driven by higher prices and that underlying consumption momentum is weakening.

The US Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) released on Thursday the September PCE data, showing a 0.5% monthly increase, up from 0.3% in August and in line with economists’ forecasts; the annual rate rose from 3.4% in August to 3.6%, the highest since May. Higher gasoline and other commodity prices were key drivers of the inflation rise.

Excluding the more volatile food and energy components, September core PCE rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, matching expectations; August’s increase was revised up from an initial 0.2% to 0.3%. The core PCE annual rate rose from 3.0% in August to 3.1%, also in line with market estimates but still well above the Fed’s 2% inflation target.

Price pressures are not limited to energy. The services‑excluding‑housing price index, often called the “super‑core” PCE that markets watch, posted its highest annual growth since December 2024, showing that service‑sector inflation remains sticky and adding to the Fed’s challenge of preventing price pressures from spreading.

The Fed kept its target rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00% on Wednesday and acknowledged in its statement that inflation is “still too high.” Chair Kevin Warsh told reporters that energy and related prices have risen again in recent weeks, and the Fed’s job is to ensure that price movements in certain sectors do not spill over to the broader economy while keeping inflation expectations anchored.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, financial markets estimate an about 83.3% probability that the Fed will raise rates in December. Although the latest PCE numbers did not exceed expectations, the simultaneous rise in headline and core inflation supports economists’ view that another rate hike is likely at year‑end.

On the consumption side, personal consumption expenditures – which account for more than two‑thirds of US economic activity – grew 0.5% in September, below the market forecast of 0.6% and slower than August’s 0.9% gain. After stripping out inflation, real consumption was flat versus the prior month, meaning spending entered the fourth quarter with weaker growth momentum.

Personal income in the same month rose only 0.2%, well under the 0.5% expected, lagging behind consumption growth and pushing the personal savings rate down to its lowest level since October 2022. Rising prices, modest income gains and a shrinking savings buffer highlight the pressure on US households.

The third‑quarter GDP advance, released the same day, showed a seasonally adjusted annualized growth rate of 3.4% for the economy, with consumption growing at the same 3.8% pace. However, the stagnation of real consumption in September reminds markets that strong overall Q3 growth does not necessarily imply equally robust demand at the end of the quarter.

items.title: 集邦：MacBook Pro新機入局 估2027年全球OLED筆電出貨年增逾40%
items.title_en: TrendForce: New MacBook Pro Enters Market, Forecasts Over 40% YoY Growth in Global OLED Laptop Shipments by 2027
paras: 研調機構TrendForce最新研究指出，Apple甫發表的MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display首度導入串聯式OLED觸控螢幕，標誌MacBook顯示技術與操作體驗的重要轉變。TrendForce預估，這款新機於2027年的出貨量將介於120-150萬台間，Apple切入OLED筆電市場，也已激勵面板廠加速相關顯示技術發展。
TrendForce分析，由於MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display起售價達2,899美元(14吋)，且初期與既有Mini-LED機種雙軌銷售，預料高價定位與產品重疊將限制短期換機動能。不過，新機進一步鞏固Apple高階產品的技術形象與溢價定位，搭配入門級MacBook Neo採取不同於以往的價格策略，反映Apple產品逐步覆蓋更廣泛的價格帶。
對OLED筆電市場而言，過去主力為Lenovo、HP、ASUS等Windows品牌，產品布局已逐步延伸至不同價位。Apple的加入有望促使品牌優先規劃OLED機種，以及提高消費者對OLED筆電的接受度，為擴大面板技術應用創造空間。TrendForce預估，即使整體筆電市場近兩年皆呈現衰退，2026年OLED筆電整機出貨量仍可望年增近40%，2027年將再成長40%以上。
目前MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display的面板由Samsung Display(SDC)獨家供應，該公司已規畫韓國牙山園區的G8.6 A6產線Phase1為Apple專線。作為其G8.6 FMM OLED產線量產的第一支model，且用於Apple進入OLED筆電的第一台、最高端旗艦機，對SDC宣示OLED市場的領先地位有指標意義。

TrendForce表示，由於MacBook Pro新機採用Tandem OLED疊層架構，且每英吋像素(PPI)達254，高規格要求對上游面板廠的材料成本、良率都是極大挑戰。因此，即便其他面板廠也有驗證項目在進行，但考量成本架構過高，加上SDC已取得第一供應商地位，LG Display、BOE、TCL CSOT等其餘OLED面板廠目前主要目標是進入MacBook Air OLED供應鏈，該機種預計於2029年發表。
paras_en: TrendForce’s latest research indicates that Apple’s newly announced MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display introduces a serial‑connected OLED touch screen for the first time, marking a significant shift in MacBook display technology and user experience. TrendForce estimates that shipments of this new model in 2027 will range between 1.2 million and 1.5 million units, and Apple’s entry into the OLED laptop market has already spurred panel makers to accelerate related display‑technology development.

TrendForce analysis notes that, with a starting price of US$2,899 for the 14‑inch model and a dual‑track sales strategy alongside existing Mini‑LED variants, the high‑price positioning and product overlap are expected to limit short‑term upgrade momentum. Nevertheless, the new model further reinforces Apple’s high‑end technical image and premium pricing, while the entry‑level MacBook Neo adopts a different pricing strategy, reflecting Apple’s gradual coverage of a broader price spectrum.

For the OLED laptop market, the main players have historically been Windows brands such as Lenovo, HP and ASUS, whose product line‑ups have gradually expanded across price tiers. Apple’s participation is expected to prompt brands to prioritize OLED models and raise consumer acceptance of OLED laptops, creating space for broader panel‑technology applications. TrendForce projects that even though the overall laptop market has been declining for the past two years, OLED laptop shipments in 2026 can still grow by nearly 40% year‑over‑year, and growth will exceed another 40% in 2027.

The display panel for the current MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is supplied exclusively by Samsung Display (SDC), which has planned a dedicated Apple line on its G8.6 A6 production line (Phase 1) at the Yashan campus in Korea. As the first model on SDC’s G8.6 FMM OLED production line and the flagship device for Apple’s entry into OLED laptops, it serves as a benchmark indicating SDC’s leading position in the OLED market.

TrendForce says that the new MacBook Pro uses a tandem OLED stack architecture with a pixel density of 254 PPI, presenting a major challenge for upstream panel makers in terms of material costs and yields. Consequently, although other panel manufacturers have verification projects underway, the high cost structure and SDC’s status as the primary supplier limit their prospects. LG Display, BOE, TCL‑CSOT and other OLED panel makers are now mainly targeting the MacBook Air OLED supply chain, with that model expected to be announced in 2029.

items.title: 竹科廠火警 嘉晶：占總產能比率低於10％以下 營運無重大影響
items.title_en: Hsinchu Science Park Plant Fire Jaci: Affected Capacity Ratio Below 10% with No Significant Operational Impact
paras: 第三代半導體廠嘉晶(3016-TW)昨(28)日位於新竹科學學園區的「嘉晶電子創新廠」慘遭祝融。嘉晶今(29)日表示，事故後即刻啟動緊急應變機制，無任何人員傷亡，對公司財務及整體營運並無重大影響，本次受影響嘉晶五座廠區中其中一座廠，此次影響為4、5吋磊晶產線，占總產值與總產能之比率低於10%。
嘉晶表示，火災事故發生後，公司即刻啟動緊急應變機制，同步通報消防單位趕赴現場處置，並迅速將該區域所有工作人員安全撤離，現場無任何人員受傷或受困，本次受影響區域為公司五座生產廠區中的其中一座廠，該廠主要生產4、5吋及部分6、8吋產品，占公司整體總產值與總產能之比率低於10%。
嘉晶指出，經初步評估災情事故，主要影響為4、5吋磊晶產線，至於6、8吋磊晶設備受電力影響，機台復原時間目前推估約需1至2周時間，公司將以快速復工為最優先目標，之後將持續進行清理及恢復廠務設施影響較低部分。
嘉晶也同步啟動各廠區之間的產能調度與備援機制，將客戶交期與營運影響降至最低，預計復工後，產能較吃緊的6、8吋產能可完全恢復。
針對本次事件，嘉晶也向新竹縣、市消防局及警消、義消同仁表達最誠摯的感謝，感謝消防隊員於第一時間迅速抵達現場、掌控火勢，以最高效率確保廠區人員安全並防止災害擴大，另對火災時的煙霧造成附近公司員工及居民困擾，亦深表歉意。
嘉晶強調，後續將全力配合主管機關進行事故原因之調查，同時完成廠區設備之安全檢查與復工，公司資產均已投保足額商業財產及營業中斷全額保險，本次事件對公司財務及整體營運並無重大影響。
paras_en: On the 28th, Jaci (3016‑TW), a third‑generation semiconductor manufacturer, suffered a severe fire at its "Jaci Electronics Innovation Plant" in the Hsinchu Science Park. The company said on the 29th that it immediately activated its emergency response plan, there were no injuries, and the incident has no material impact on its finances or overall operations. The fire affected one of Jaci’s five factories, specifically the 4‑inch and 5‑inch wafer production line, which accounts for less than 10% of total output and capacity.

Jaci stated that after the fire broke out, the company promptly triggered its emergency response mechanism, notified fire services who rushed to the scene, and quickly evacuated all personnel from the area. No one was injured or trapped. The affected area is one of the five production sites, mainly producing 4‑inch, 5‑inch and some 6‑inch and 8‑inch products, representing less than 10% of the company’s total output and capacity.

Jaci indicated that a preliminary assessment shows the main impact is on the 4‑inch and 5‑inch wafer lines. The 6‑inch and 8‑inch equipment suffered power issues, and restoration of those machines is estimated to take about one to two weeks. The company will prioritize rapid resumption of work and will continue cleaning and restoring less‑affected facilities.

Jaci also activated capacity scheduling and backup mechanisms across its plants to minimize customer delivery delays and operational impact. After resuming production, the tighter‑supply 6‑inch and 8‑inch capacity is expected to be fully restored.

Regarding the incident, Jaci expressed sincere gratitude to the Hsinchu County and City fire bureaus, as well as volunteer and rescue firefighters, for arriving promptly, controlling the blaze, ensuring personnel safety, and preventing further damage. The company also apologizes for the smoke inconvenience caused to nearby employees and residents.

Jaci emphasized that it will fully cooperate with regulators in investigating the cause, complete safety inspections of plant equipment, and resume operations. All assets are fully insured for commercial property and business interruption, and the event has no material impact on the company’s financials or overall operations.

items.title: 〈瑞昱法說〉Q4淡季不淡、Wi-Fi 8明年下半年放量 2030年HPC及邊緣AI營收占比拚3成
items.title_en: Realtek Earnings Call: Q4 Not Slow Despite Seasonality, Wi‑Fi 8 to Ramp Up in H2 2027, Aim for >30% HPC and Edge AI Revenue Share by 2030
paras: 網通晶片廠瑞昱(2379-TW)今(29)日舉行法說會，瑞昱表示，受惠高規格產品組合及價格調整帶動平均售價(ASP)提升，第四季營運有望淡季不淡，即使PC需求進一步走弱，營收仍可能避免往常的季節性放緩。展望2027年，公司預期營收將穩健成長，並持續布局Wi-Fi 8、車載乙太網路、高速傳輸及邊緣AI等應用，其中Wi-Fi 8解決方案預計明年下半年開始放量。
針對第四季營運展望，瑞昱指出，整體營運動能目前維持穩定，較佳的產品組合及價格調整帶動平均售價提升，將有助抵銷部分PC需求走弱的影響。不過，晶圓代工與封測成本持續上漲，以及供應鏈產能分配仍是重要外部變數，公司將持續與供應鏈夥伴及客戶協調，並採取審慎的定價策略。
展望2027年，瑞昱維持營收穩健成長的看法，主要動能來自平均售價提升、產品規格升級及新產品推出。公司也將在維持毛利率穩定的前提下，兼顧營收成長、市占率與獲利能力。
在無線連網技術方面，瑞昱表示，Wi-Fi 7在個人電腦與路由器市場的滲透率預計今年達約30%，2027年可望進一步提升至約40%。至於次世代Wi-Fi 8，公司持續參與前期測試及規格制定，認證測試計畫目標於2027年6月完成，官方認證預計同年9月啟動，旗下解決方案則將於2027年下半年開始放量，2028年客戶採用可望更加廣泛。
車載與實體AI方面，瑞昱指出，車載乙太網路在全球新車市場的滲透率已突破50%。儘管整體汽車出貨量大致持平，但隨著車廠轉向區域控制架構，每車乙太網路連接埠數增加，有助推升單車晶片價值。瑞昱持續拓展車用乙太網路交換器及閘道控制器產品，並已獲全球車廠及一線供應商設計導入。
機器人方面，由於內部連網技術與車載應用具有高度相容性，瑞昱連網解決方案已導入第一波主要商用機器人，並與全球領先的人形機器人開發商合作，供應原型機及早期導入專案，持續布局實體AI應用。
在高速傳輸與雲端運算方面，瑞昱表示，多千兆乙太網路解決方案占整體乙太網路營收比重已超過40%。隨著本地端大型語言模型(LLM)運算需求增加，終端電腦也持續升級至5G、10G乙太網路規格。光通訊方面，100G光學實體層(PHY)晶片正進行客戶認證，預期2027年放量將更為顯著；400G與800G PAM4數位訊號處理器(DSP)則按計畫開發，預計2027年下半年推出。
瑞昱進一步指出，目前高效能運算(HPC)與邊緣AI相關業務占總營收比重為高個位數百分比，涵蓋車用、機器人及相關運算應用。公司設定中長期目標，預計至2030年將高效能運算與邊緣AI營收占比提升至30%以上，並持續拓展乙太網路、交換器、儲存控制器及高速互連等產品在AI伺服器與基礎設施的應用。
paras_en: Realtek (2379‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (29th). The company said that thanks to a high‑spec product mix and price adjustments that lifted average selling price (ASP), Q4 operations are expected to avoid the usual seasonal slowdown. Even if PC demand weakens further, revenue may still dodge the typical seasonal dip. Looking ahead to 2027, the firm expects steady revenue growth and continues to invest in Wi‑Fi 8, automotive Ethernet, high‑speed transport and edge AI applications, with Wi‑Fi 8 solutions slated to scale from the second half of next year.

Regarding the Q4 outlook, Realtek noted that overall operating momentum remains stable. A better product mix and price adjustments that raise ASP will help offset some of the impact from weaker PC demand. However, rising wafer‑foundry and test‑pack costs, as well as supply‑chain capacity allocation, remain key external variables. The company will keep coordinating with supply‑chain partners and customers and will adopt a prudent pricing strategy.

Looking to 2027, Realtek maintains its view of steady revenue growth, driven mainly by higher ASPs, upgraded product specifications and new product launches. The firm will aim to keep gross margins stable while balancing revenue growth, market share and profitability.

In wireless networking, Realtek said Wi‑Fi 7 penetration in PCs and routers is expected to reach about 30% this year and roughly 40% by 2027. For next‑generation Wi‑Fi 8, the company continues early‑stage testing and specification work, targeting certification test completion by June 2027, official certification in September 2027, and volume production of its solutions starting in the second half of 2027, with broader customer adoption anticipated in 2028.

On automotive and physical AI, Realtek noted that automotive Ethernet penetration in the global new‑car market has already exceeded 50%. Although overall vehicle shipments are roughly flat, automakers are shifting to zone‑control architectures, increasing the number of Ethernet ports per vehicle and boosting per‑car chip value. Realtek is expanding its automotive Ethernet switch and gateway controller portfolio and has secured design adoption from global OEMs and tier‑1 suppliers.

Regarding robotics, because its internal networking technology is highly compatible with automotive applications, Realtek’s networking solutions have been incorporated into the first wave of major commercial robots. The company is also working with leading humanoid robot developers to supply prototype units and early‑stage deployment projects, further building out physical‑AI use cases.

In high‑speed transport and cloud computing, Realtek said multi‑gigabit Ethernet solutions now account for over 40% of total Ethernet revenue. As demand for on‑premise large language model (LLM) processing grows, end‑point devices are upgrading to 5G and 10G Ethernet specs. In optics, its 100G optical PHY chip is undergoing customer qualification, with volume expected to rise sharply in 2027; 400G and 800G PAM4 digital signal processors are on schedule, slated for release in the second half of 2027.

Realtek added that today its high‑performance computing (HPC) and edge‑AI businesses represent a high‑single‑digit percentage of total revenue, covering automotive, robotics and related compute applications. The company has set a mid‑to‑long‑term goal to lift the share of HPC and edge‑AI revenue to over 30% by 2030, while continuing to expand Ethernet, switch, storage controller and high‑speed interconnect products for AI servers and infrastructure.

items.title: 集邦：MacBook Pro新機入局 估2027年全球OLED筆電出貨年增逾40%
items.title_en: TrendForce: New MacBook Pro Enters Market, Forecasts Over 40% YoY Growth in Global OLED Laptop Shipments by 2027
paras: 研調機構TrendForce最新研究指出，Apple甫發表的MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display首度導入串聯式OLED觸控螢幕，標誌MacBook顯示技術與操作體驗的重要轉變。TrendForce預估，這款新機於2027年的出貨量將介於120-150萬台間，Apple切入OLED筆電市場，也已激勵面板廠加速相關顯示技術發展。
TrendForce分析，由於MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display起售價達2,899美元(14吋)，且初期與既有Mini-LED機種雙軌銷售，預料高價定位與產品重疊將限制短期換機動能。不過，新機進一步鞏固Apple高階產品的技術形象與溢價定位，搭配入門級MacBook Neo採取不同於以往的價格策略，反映Apple產品逐步覆蓋更廣泛的價格帶。
對OLED筆電市場而言，過去主力為Lenovo、HP、ASUS等Windows品牌，產品布局已逐步延伸至不同價位。Apple的加入有望促使品牌優先規劃OLED機種，以及提高消費者對OLED筆電的接受度，為擴大面板技術應用創造空間。TrendForce預估，即使整體筆電市場近兩年皆呈現衰退，2026年OLED筆電整機出貨量仍可望年增近40%，2027年將再成長40%以上。
目前MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display的面板由Samsung Display(SDC)獨家供應，該公司已規畫韓國牙山園區的G8.6 A6產線Phase1為Apple專線。作為其G8.6 FMM OLED產線量產的第一支model，且用於Apple進入OLED筆電的第一台、最高端旗艦機，對SDC宣示OLED市場的領先地位有指標意義。

TrendForce表示，由於MacBook Pro新機採用Tandem OLED疊層架構，且每英吋像素(PPI)達254，高規格要求對上游面板廠的材料成本、良率都是極大挑戰。因此，即便其他面板廠也有驗證項目在進行，但考量成本架構過高，加上SDC已取得第一供應商地位，LG Display、BOE、TCL CSOT等其餘OLED面板廠目前主要目標是進入MacBook Air OLED供應鏈，該機種預計於2029年發表。
paras_en: TrendForce’s latest research indicates that Apple’s newly announced MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display introduces a serial‑connected OLED touch screen for the first time, marking a significant shift in MacBook display technology and user experience. TrendForce estimates that shipments of this new model in 2027 will range between 1.2 million and 1.5 million units, and Apple’s entry into the OLED laptop market has already spurred panel makers to accelerate related display‑technology development.

TrendForce analysis notes that, with a starting price of US$2,899 for the 14‑inch model and a dual‑track sales strategy alongside existing Mini‑LED variants, the high‑price positioning and product overlap are expected to limit short‑term upgrade momentum. Nevertheless, the new model further reinforces Apple’s high‑end technical image and premium pricing, while the entry‑level MacBook Neo adopts a different pricing strategy, reflecting Apple’s gradual coverage of a broader price spectrum.

For the OLED laptop market, the main players have historically been Windows brands such as Lenovo, HP and ASUS, whose product line‑ups have gradually expanded across price tiers. Apple’s participation is expected to prompt brands to prioritize OLED models and raise consumer acceptance of OLED laptops, creating space for broader panel‑technology applications. TrendForce projects that even though the overall laptop market has been declining for the past two years, OLED laptop shipments in 2026 can still grow by nearly 40% year‑over‑year, and growth will exceed another 40% in 2027.

The display panel for the current MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is supplied exclusively by Samsung Display (SDC), which has planned a dedicated Apple line on its G8.6 A6 production line (Phase 1) at the Yashan campus in Korea. As the first model on SDC’s G8.6 FMM OLED production line and the flagship device for Apple’s entry into OLED laptops, it serves as a benchmark indicating SDC’s leading position in the OLED market.

TrendForce says that the new MacBook Pro uses a tandem OLED stack architecture with a pixel density of 254 PPI, presenting a major challenge for upstream panel makers in terms of material costs and yields. Consequently, although other panel manufacturers have verification projects underway, the high cost structure and SDC’s status as the primary supplier limit their prospects. LG Display, BOE, TCL‑CSOT and other OLED panel makers are now mainly targeting the MacBook Air OLED supply chain, with that model expected to be announced in 2029.

items.title: 竹科廠火警 嘉晶：占總產能比率低於10％以下 營運無重大影響
items.title_en: Hsinchu Science Park Plant Fire Jaci: Affected Capacity Ratio Below 10% with No Significant Operational Impact
paras: 第三代半導體廠嘉晶(3016-TW)昨(28)日位於新竹科學學園區的「嘉晶電子創新廠」慘遭祝融。嘉晶今(29)日表示，事故後即刻啟動緊急應變機制，無任何人員傷亡，對公司財務及整體營運並無重大影響，本次受影響嘉晶五座廠區中其中一座廠，此次影響為4、5吋磊晶產線，占總產值與總產能之比率低於10%。
嘉晶表示，火災事故發生後，公司即刻啟動緊急應變機制，同步通報消防單位趕赴現場處置，並迅速將該區域所有工作人員安全撤離，現場無任何人員受傷或受困，本次受影響區域為公司五座生產廠區中的其中一座廠，該廠主要生產4、5吋及部分6、8吋產品，占公司整體總產值與總產能之比率低於10%。
嘉晶指出，經初步評估災情事故，主要影響為4、5吋磊晶產線，至於6、8吋磊晶設備受電力影響，機台復原時間目前推估約需1至2周時間，公司將以快速復工為最優先目標，之後將持續進行清理及恢復廠務設施影響較低部分。
嘉晶也同步啟動各廠區之間的產能調度與備援機制，將客戶交期與營運影響降至最低，預計復工後，產能較吃緊的6、8吋產能可完全恢復。
針對本次事件，嘉晶也向新竹縣、市消防局及警消、義消同仁表達最誠摯的感謝，感謝消防隊員於第一時間迅速抵達現場、掌控火勢，以最高效率確保廠區人員安全並防止災害擴大，另對火災時的煙霧造成附近公司員工及居民困擾，亦深表歉意。
嘉晶強調，後續將全力配合主管機關進行事故原因之調查，同時完成廠區設備之安全檢查與復工，公司資產均已投保足額商業財產及營業中斷全額保險，本次事件對公司財務及整體營運並無重大影響。
paras_en: On the 28th, Jaci (3016‑TW), a third‑generation semiconductor manufacturer, suffered a severe fire at its "Jaci Electronics Innovation Plant" in the Hsinchu Science Park. The company said on the 29th that it immediately activated its emergency response plan, there were no injuries, and the incident has no material impact on its finances or overall operations. The fire affected one of Jaci’s five factories, specifically the 4‑inch and 5‑inch wafer production line, which accounts for less than 10% of total output and capacity.

Jaci stated that after the fire broke out, the company promptly triggered its emergency response mechanism, notified fire services who rushed to the scene, and quickly evacuated all personnel from the area. No one was injured or trapped. The affected area is one of the five production sites, mainly producing 4‑inch, 5‑inch and some 6‑inch and 8‑inch products, representing less than 10% of the company’s total output and capacity.

Jaci indicated that a preliminary assessment shows the main impact is on the 4‑inch and 5‑inch wafer lines. The 6‑inch and 8‑inch equipment suffered power issues, and restoration of those machines is estimated to take about one to two weeks. The company will prioritize rapid resumption of work and will continue cleaning and restoring less‑affected facilities.

Jaci also activated capacity scheduling and backup mechanisms across its plants to minimize customer delivery delays and operational impact. After resuming production, the tighter‑supply 6‑inch and 8‑inch capacity is expected to be fully restored.

Regarding the incident, Jaci expressed sincere gratitude to the Hsinchu County and City fire bureaus, as well as volunteer and rescue firefighters, for arriving promptly, controlling the blaze, ensuring personnel safety, and preventing further damage. The company also apologizes for the smoke inconvenience caused to nearby employees and residents.

Jaci emphasized that it will fully cooperate with regulators in investigating the cause, complete safety inspections of plant equipment, and resume operations. All assets are fully insured for commercial property and business interruption, and the event has no material impact on the company’s financials or overall operations.

items.title: 〈瑞昱法說〉Q3純益年增2成EPS8.05元 前三季每股賺23.91元
items.title_en: Realtek Earnings Briefing: Q3 Net Profit Up 20% EPS 8.05 TWD, First‑Three‑Quarter EPS 23.91 TWD
paras: 網通晶片龍頭瑞昱(2379-TW)今29日舉行線上法人說明會並公布2026年第三季財報，受惠網通基礎建設需求穩健帶動產品規格升級，單季稅後純益達41億元，較去年同期顯著成長，每股純益達8.05元，累計前三季每股純益來到23.91元。
瑞昱第三季營收 377.3 億元，季增 0.5%，年增 27.9%；毛利率 47.4%，季增 0.4 個百分點，年減 2.3 個百分點；營業利益 41.4 億元，季增 11.2%，年增 33.1%；營益率 11.0%，季增 1.1 個百分點，年增 0.4 個百分點。稅後純益 41.3 億元，季增 8.4%，年增 20.3%，每股純益 8.05 元。
在終端市場結構部分，瑞昱第三季個人電腦相關應用營收占比約為30%，非個人電腦應用則占70%。受零組件成本通膨及記憶體與處理器價格居高不下衝擊，全球個人電腦終端出貨面臨兩成以上的衰退壓力，但瑞昱旗下周邊晶片需求相對具有支撐，且多千兆乙太網路、高階音訊編解碼器與AI相機控制器等高規格產品滲透率提高，減緩了整機出貨疲軟的負面衝擊。
網通基礎建設持續扮演第三季主要營運支柱，寬頻路由器、無源光纖網路、中小企業網路及伺服器帶動多千兆乙太網路晶片穩健成長，管理型交換器在企業與伺服器控制平面市場的市占率亦持續擴大。物聯網業務則在智慧家庭與邊緣裝置需求帶動下呈現季增與年增，車用乙太網路亦受惠新車單車搭載連接埠數量增加而維持穩定增長態勢。
針對市場關注的庫存健康度，瑞昱第三季庫存週轉天數由上季的107天上升至136天。瑞昱說明，庫存天數增加主要反映公司為確保供應鏈不確定性下的供貨連續性，主動針對客戶策略性建立已知良好晶粒庫存，目前整體客戶端與通路端的庫存水位依然維持健康狀態。
paras_en: Realtek (2379‑TW), the leading network‑chip maker, held an online analyst briefing on the 29th and released its 2026 third‑quarter results. Benefiting from steady demand for network infrastructure that drove product upgrades, the company posted a quarterly after‑tax net profit of NT$4.1 billion, a marked increase from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$8.05. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, EPS reached NT$23.91.

In Q3, Realtek’s revenue was NT$37.73 billion, up 0.5% sequentially and 27.9% year‑on‑year; gross margin was 47.4%, up 0.4 percentage points sequentially but down 2.3 points year‑on‑year. Operating profit was NT$4.14 billion, up 11.2% sequentially and 33.1% year‑on‑year, giving an operating margin of 11.0%, up 1.1 points sequentially and 0.4 points year‑on‑year. After‑tax net profit was NT$4.13 billion, up 8.4% sequentially and 20.3% year‑on‑year, translating to EPS of NT$8.05.

Regarding end‑market structure, about 30% of Realtek’s Q3 revenue came from personal‑computer‑related applications, with the remaining 70% from non‑PC applications. Although component‑cost inflation and persistently high memory and processor prices have put more than 20% downward pressure on global PC shipments, demand for Realtek’s peripheral chips remains relatively supportive. Moreover, higher penetration of multi‑gigabit Ethernet, high‑end audio codecs and AI camera controllers has helped offset the negative impact of weak overall device shipments.

Network‑infrastructure continued to be the main operating pillar in Q3. Broadband routers, passive optical networks, SMB networking and servers drove solid growth for multi‑gigabit Ethernet chips, while the market share of managed switches in enterprise and server control‑plane markets kept expanding. IoT business showed both sequential and year‑on‑year growth, spurred by smart‑home and edge‑device demand, and automotive Ethernet maintained stable growth as new‑car models added more connectivity ports.

Addressing concerns about inventory health, Realtek’s inventory turnover days rose from 107 days in the prior quarter to 136 days in Q3. The company explained that the increase reflects a proactive strategy to build known‑good wafer inventory for customers in order to ensure supply continuity amid supply‑chain uncertainties; overall inventory levels at both the customer and channel sides remain healthy.

• ATM 半導體封測業務（核心引擎）：
ATM 第三季營收達 1,515 億元（季增 20%、年增 51%），佔集團營收 62%，但貢獻高達 91% 的營業利益。
ATM 毛利率衝上 30.6%（季增 3.3 個百分點、年增 8.0 個百分點），ATM 營業利益率達 20.0%（季增 4.3 個百分點）。管理層強調過去 30% 的「結構性毛利率天花板」如今已正式轉化為「毛利率的新底線（Base）」。
• EMS 電子代工製造業務：
受惠 SiP 季節性拉貨與 AI 加速卡模組出貨，第三季營收達 935 億元（季增 42%、年增 35%）。
由於 AI 零組件短缺導致轉嫁零組件成本（Pass-through costs）提高，營收放大但稀釋獲利率，毛利率降至 8.3%，營業利益率為 3.3%（營業利益 31 億元）。
• 財務結構與負債比率： 期末現金與約當金融資產為 1,079 億元，總計息負債為 4,065 億元，EBITDA 為 580 億元，淨負債權益比（Net Debt to Equity）為 66%（落於近期高峰，第四季將逐步下降）。
資本支出與重大產能擴建（三度上修）：
• 2026 全年 CapEx 再度追加 10 億美元： 董事會將今年資本支出預算由先前上修的 105 億美元進一步提高至 115 億美元（其中 5 億美元投入廠房設施，5 億美元購置設備；設備中 60% 專注於 LEAP 先進封測、40% 用於主流高階封裝）。
• 前三季累計資本支出已達 80 億美元（設備 48 億美元、廠房設施 32 億美元）。
• 全台 22 處建案並行： 廠房空間為當前最大瓶頸，目前全台共有 22 座正在興建或改造的廠房專案，其中超過半數將自現階段至 2027 年間陸續投產挹注營收。
應用別與產品業務動態：
• 運算（Computing）躍居成長核心： 隨先進封裝 LEAP 技術大規模導入，ATM 運算應用營收單季激增 39%；車用、工控與消費性均成長約 14%；通訊成長 8%。
• LEAP 先進封裝全面定義未來： LEAP 不僅局限於 AI，多晶片互連（Multi-chip interconnect / Chiplet）與系統微縮已成半導體演進常態，裝機速度與產能擴充持續超前。
二、 2026 年第四季營運指引 (Guidance)
以新台幣對美元匯率 31.9 : 1 為基準假設：
• 合併營收（集團整體）：預期季增 6% 至 8%。
• 合併毛利率：預計介於 23.0% 至 24.0% 之間。
• 合併營業利益率：預計介於 14.5% 至 15.5% 之間。
• ATM 業務營收：預期季增 11% 至 13%。
• ATM 業務毛利率：預計較第三季（30.6%）再增加 100 至 200 個基點（達到 31.6%~32.6%）。
• EMS 業務：營收預計與第三季大致持平，營業利益率約在 2.0% 左右。
三、 法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)
Q1：2026 年與 2027 年 LEAP 先進封測業務的營收目標？ (Sunny Lin, UBS)
回答：
2026 年：將原先預估的 37 億美元正式上調至超過 40 億美元。
2027 年：維持先前翻倍成長的預期，2027 年 LEAP 營收將較 2026 年再倍增（Double）。
Q2：全製程（Full-process CoWoS）先進封裝進度與 2027 年展望？ (Sunny Lin, UBS / Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan)
回答： 2026 年全製程營收符合進度，維持全年 3 億美元目標，良率已達到量產與大規模出貨水準；2027 年全製程營收預估將突破 10 億美元（> $1B USD）。目前面臨的最大瓶頸仍在於廠房空間限制，實際客戶需求遠高於日月光所能供應的產能。
Q3：ATM 毛利率突破 30% 之後的長期區間？後續能否逐季持續擴張？ (Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan / Haas Liu, BofA)
回答： 隨著 LEAP 業務快速爬坡且整體產能稼動率滿載，過去的「30% 結構性毛利率天花板」現在已變成未來的「基準底線（Base）」。在正向有利的定價環境與產品組合持續優化下，預期 2027 年 ATM 毛利率將以 30% 為起點，呈現逐季季增（Sequential improvement）的走勢。LEAP 相關的封裝與測試均具備拉升整體 Margin 的效益。
Q4：共同封裝光學（CPO）業務佈局與 2027 年營收規模？ (Laura Chen, Citi / Haas Liu, BofA / Sunny Lin, UBS)
回答： 日月光在 CPO 領域扮演最積極的推動者，與晶圓代工夥伴及終端客戶緊密合作。CPO 已於 2026 年第四季正式啟動量產，預估 2027 年 CPO 營收貢獻將超過 5 億美元（> $0.5B USD）（涵蓋在 LEAP 營收範疇內）。此外，若市場對 NPO 有實質需求，日月光亦具備完整封裝能力。
Q5：2027 年資本支出（CapEx）趨勢與資金籌措規劃？ (Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan / Haas Liu, BofA)
回答： 考量終端訂單極度強勁且客戶藍圖持續擴展，2027 年資本支出預計將高於 2026 年（> 115 億美元）。公司絕不會因保守而錯失擴張機會，將運用多元且具成本效益的融資管道（包含與客戶簽訂特定預付款/貿易融資安排）；雖然大規模擴產將導致自由現金流短期呈現負數，但後續營運效益開出後將自然回本平衡。
Q6：封裝（Assembly）與測試（Test）的產能瓶頸與資源分配順序？ (Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan)
回答： 由於當前廠房空間有限，單位空間投入於封裝的生產效益高於測試，因此在資源受限下，公司將資源優先挹注於封裝產能擴建；在測試端則優先擴充晶圓測試（Wafer sort / CP），次之才是最終測試（FT）。預計 2027 年封裝成長增速仍將快於測試。
Q7：如何看待台積電子公司（如精材等）切入 On-substrate 封裝業務的競爭？ (Charlie Chan, Morgan Stanley)
回答： 日月光在先進封測領域擁有壓倒性的規模與龍頭地位（Dominant player）。晶圓代工夥伴及客戶擴大封測供應鏈是基於產能供不應求的必要舉措，不會對整體市占版圖產生實質撼動；市場需求過於龐大，競爭核心在於誰能擠出更多廠房空間與設備，完全不存在價格競爭或價格戰的疑慮。
Q8：非 AI 終端市場（PC、智慧手機、車用與工控）的市況與能見度？ (Charlie Chan, Morgan Stanley)
回答： 雖然手機與 PC 受到高零組件成本（DRAM/CPU 漲價）壓抑終端需求，但車用、工控全面復甦，加上 AI 鄰近周邊晶片（AI-adjacent chips）需求強勁挹注，帶動 2026 全年非 AI 的通用主流市場（General market）營收繳出超過 20% 的高度成長，預期該成長動能將一路延續至 2027 年。
Q9：EMS 業務在 2027 年上半年的淡季走向與長期定位？ (Sunny Lin, UBS)
回答： EMS 業務正加速朝高效能運算（HPC / AI 加速器模組，營收佔比已達 mid-teens）、矽光子光學連接與電源整合模組轉型。雖然消費性與通訊拉貨節奏隨客戶排程變化，但在 AI 伺服器硬體需求推動下，預期 2027 年 EMS 仍將維持成長態勢。
paras_en: 1. 2026 Q3 Financial and Operational Details
2. Financial Performance:
3. • Revenue and profit reached historic highs: Q3 2026 consolidated net revenue was NT$244.2 billion, up 28% QoQ and 45% YoY.
4. • Gross margin broke through a historic structural ceiling:
5. Consolidated gross profit was NT$54.0 billion, with the gross margin climbing to 22.1% (up 1.1 percentage points QoQ and 5.0 points YoY).

6. Operating expense ratio fell to 8.5% (operating expenses NT$20.8 billion); operating profit was NT$33.1 billion (up 57% QoQ and 151% YoY), and operating profit margin rose to 13.6% (up 2.5 percentage points QoQ and 5.8 points YoY).
7. Net profit after tax for the quarter was NT$27.0 billion (up 28% QoQ and 148% YoY). Basic EPS was NT$6.13, diluted EPS was NT$5.84.
8. Cumulative performance for the first three quarters: cumulative basic EPS was NT$14.17 (diluted EPS NT$13.40).
9. • ATM semiconductor packaging and testing business (core engine):
10. ATM Q3 revenue reached NT$151.5 billion (up 20% QoQ and 51% YoY), accounting for 62% of group revenue but contributing a massive 91% of operating profit.

11. ATM gross margin surged to 30.6% (up 3.3 percentage points QoQ and 8.0 points YoY), and ATM operating margin reached 20.0% (up 4.3 points QoQ). Management emphasized that the previous 30% “structural gross‑margin ceiling” has now become the new baseline for margin.
12. • EMS electronic manufacturing services business:
13. Benefiting from seasonal SiP shipments and AI accelerator‑card module shipments, Q3 revenue was NT$93.5 billion (up 42% QoQ and 35% YoY).

14. Due to AI component shortages leading to higher pass‑through costs, revenue expanded but diluted earnings, gross margin fell to 8.3% and operating margin was 3.3% (operating profit NT$3.1 billion).

15. • Financial structure and debt ratio: End‑of‑period cash and cash equivalents were NT$107.9 billion, total interest‑bearing debt was NT$406.5 billion, EBITDA was NT$58.0 billion, and net‑debt‑to‑equity stood at 66% (near a recent peak, expected to gradually decline in Q4).
16. Capital expenditures and major capacity expansions (third upward revision):

17. • 2026 full‑year CapEx increased by another US$1 billion: the board raised this year’s capex budget from the previously revised US$10.5 billion to US$11.5 billion (US$0.5 billion for plant facilities and US$0.5 billion for equipment; 60% of equipment spending focuses on LEAP advanced packaging, 40% on mainstream high‑end packaging).
18. • Cumulative capex for the first three quarters reached US$8 billion (US$4.8 billion for equipment, US$3.2 billion for plant facilities).

19. • 22 construction projects across Taiwan proceeding in parallel: plant space is the current biggest bottleneck; there are 22 factories under construction or renovation nationwide, with more than half slated to come online between now and 2027, adding to revenue.
20. Application and product business dynamics:

21. • Computing rose to become the core growth driver: with large‑scale adoption of the advanced LEAP packaging, ATM computing‑application revenue jumped 39% in the quarter; automotive, industrial control and consumer segments each grew about 14%; communications grew 8%.

22. • LEAP advanced packaging defines the future: LEAP is no longer limited to AI; multi‑chip interconnect (chiplet) and system‑in‑package have become the norm in semiconductor evolution, with installation speed and capacity expansion staying ahead of demand.
23. 2. 2026 Q4 Operating Guidance
24. Assuming an exchange rate of NT$31.9 per US$1:
25. • Consolidated revenue (group‑wide): expected QoQ growth of 6% to 8%.
26. • Consolidated gross margin: projected between 23.0% and 24.0%.
27. • Consolidated operating margin: projected between 14.5% and 15.5%.
28. • ATM business revenue: expected QoQ growth of 11% to 13%.
29. • ATM business gross margin: expected to increase by 100 to 200 basis points from the Q3 level of 30.6%, reaching roughly 31.6%–32.6%.
30. • EMS business: revenue expected to be roughly flat versus Q3, with operating margin around 2.0%.
31. 3. Full Q&A List from the Conference
32. Q1: Revenue targets for LEAP advanced packaging in 2026 and 2027? (Sunny Lin, UBS)
33. Answer:
34. 2026: The original estimate of US$3.7 billion has been formally raised to over US$4 billion.
35. 2027: The prior expectation of a double‑year‑over‑year growth is maintained; 2027 LEAP revenue will double again relative to 2026.
36. Q2: Progress and outlook for Full‑process CoWoS advanced packaging in 2027? (Sunny Lin, UBS / Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan)

37. Answer: Full‑process revenue in 2026 is on schedule, keeping the full‑year target of US$300 million, with yields at mass‑production and large‑scale shipment levels; 2027 full‑process revenue is projected to exceed US$1 billion. The biggest bottleneck remains plant space, as actual customer demand far exceeds ASE’s available capacity.
38. Q3: Long‑term range after ATM gross margin broke 30%? Can it keep expanding quarter over quarter? (Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan / Haas Liu, BofA)

39. Answer: With LEAP business ramping quickly and overall capacity utilization at full tilt, the former “30% structural gross‑margin ceiling” has become the new baseline. In a favorable pricing environment and with an optimized product mix, ATM gross margin is expected to start from 30% in 2027 and improve sequentially each quarter. LEAP‑related packaging and testing both contribute to lifting overall margin.
40. Q4: CPO (Co‑Packaged Optics) business layout and 2027 revenue scale? (Laura Chen, Citi / Haas Liu, BofA / Sunny Lin, UBS)

41. Answer: ASE is the most proactive player in CPO, working closely with foundry partners and end customers. CPO entered volume production in Q4 2026, and 2027 CPO revenue is expected to exceed US$500 million (included in LEAP revenue). Moreover, if the market shows real demand for NPO, ASE has full packaging capability.
42. Q5: 2027 CapEx trend and financing plan? (Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan / Haas Liu, BofA)

43. Answer: Given extremely strong end‑customer orders and expanding blueprints, 2027 capex is expected to be higher than 2026 (above US$11.5 billion). The company will not miss expansion opportunities out of conservatism and will use diversified, cost‑effective financing channels (including specific pre‑payment/trade‑finance arrangements with customers). Although large‑scale expansion will temporarily push free cash flow negative, operating benefits will eventually repay the outlay.
44. Q6: Capacity bottlenecks and resource allocation order for Assembly and Test? (Gokul Hariharan, JP Morgan)

45. Answer: Because plant space is limited, the return on space invested in assembly is higher than in test, so under constrained resources the company will prioritize assembly capacity expansion; for test, wafer sort/CP will be expanded first, followed by final test (FT). Assembly growth in 2027 is expected to outpace test growth.
46. Q7: How do you view competition from companies like TSMC’s subsidiaries entering on‑substrate packaging? (Charlie Chan, Morgan Stanley)

47. Answer: ASE holds an overwhelming scale and leading position in advanced packaging and testing. Foundry partners and customers are expanding the packaging supply chain out of capacity shortage, which will not materially shift the overall market share landscape; the market is so large that competition is about who can secure more plant space and equipment, not about price wars.
48. Q8: Market conditions and visibility for non‑AI end markets (PC, smartphones, automotive, industrial control)? (Charlie Chan, Morgan Stanley)

49. Answer: Although smartphones and PCs face suppressed demand due to high component costs (DRAM/CPU price hikes), automotive and industrial control are fully recovering, and strong demand for AI‑adjacent chips is boosting the general‑market revenue, which grew over 20% in 2026. This growth momentum is expected to continue into 2027.
50. Q9: Outlook for EMS business in the first half of 2027 and its long‑term positioning? (Sunny Lin, UBS)

51. Answer: EMS is accelerating its transition toward high‑performance computing and AI accelerator modules (now accounting for the mid‑teens percent of revenue), silicon‑photonics optical interconnects, and power‑integrated modules. While consumer and communications pull‑in cycles follow customer schedules, AI server hardware demand will keep EMS on a growth trajectory in 2027.

items.title: 〈台達電法說〉Q4營收估季增、毛利率不低於上季 馬國將設大型生產據點
items.title_en: Delta Electronics Earnings Call: Q4 Revenue Expected to Rise Quarter‑over‑Quarter, Gross Margin Not Below Prior Quarter; Large Production Site Planned in Malaysia
paras: 台達電(2308-TW)今(29)日召開法說會，董事長鄭平表示，第四季營收一定高於第三季，毛利率則不會比第三季差，但年底仍有部分無形資產等項目需要檢視。展望明年，隨著AI資料中心建置需求持續，預期整體營運仍將維持成長趨勢，AI及資料中心相關業務將持續扮演主要成長動能。全球產能布局方面，台達電董事會已通過在馬來西亞檳城設立大型生產據點。
針對近期庫存增加及跌價損失，鄭平指出，今年營運環境較為複雜，受到客戶拉貨時程、設計與品質規格調整，以及供應商交期延誤、長短料等因素影響，導致部分庫存堆積，屬於短期狀況，預期相關庫存將自第四季起陸續去化；第三季提列備抵存貨跌價損失約占營收1.7%，隨著相關問題逐步解決、存貨順利出貨，部分損失有機會迴轉。
此外，受到原物料成本上升影響，台達電今年以來材料成本約增加2%，目前已陸續與客戶協商價格調整，部分價格可能在第四季反映，也有部分延至明年第一季。
在AI業務方面，鄭平指出，今年與AI相關的業務已占整體營收約一半，涵蓋電源、散熱、零組件及資訊通信等事業，其中電源解決方案事業群(PSBG)的AI相關營收占比約25%；液冷散熱方面，前三季營收約250億元，占整體營收約13%，預估全年比重也將維持在13%左右。展望明年，台達電看好相關業務仍將延續成長趨勢。
台達電表示，AI資料中心建置是近年產業成長的主要動能，從大型AI業者的營收成長及現金流表現來看，需求持續性比原先預期更好，超大規模雲端服務業者(Hyperscaler)及新興雲端業者對資料中心的資本支出仍有支撐。他預估，四大Hyperscaler今年全年資本支出將達7,000億美元以上，明年全球資料中心資本支出可能達1.2兆至1.5兆美元，長期建置需求可望延續至2030年。
不過，AI需求雖然明確，但鄭平直言，供應鏈營收成長不見得會呈現平順曲線，短期仍可能受到材料短缺、電力供應、技術人力不足及地方政府審批等因素影響，導致資料中心建置進度提前或延後，進而使出貨時程出現波動。 他指出，隨著半導體及被動元件等材料需求快速增加，部分供應鏈產能難以立即跟上。
此外，資料中心缺電問題也日益嚴重，預估至2030年，全球資料中心用電量可能較目前增加一倍。除加速電廠建設外，燃氣發電、小型核能及固態氧化物燃料電池(SOFC)等方案，也有機會成為補足電力需求的途徑。台達電SOFC預計明年量產，至於高壓直流(HVDC)電源架構，±400V已於第三季開始出貨，800V直流則預計明年持續推進。
關於馬來西亞大型生產據點，鄭平說明，公司評估多個地點後，認為檳城具備理工科人才及產業環境優勢，有助於支援自動化工廠運作，未來也可延伸製程研發及研發中心布局，希望檳城生產基地未來的產能規模能比照泰國，但不會立即達成，目標是在五年內逐步達到相當規模，實際進度仍須視整體市場成長情況調整。
paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) held its earnings conference today (29th). Chairman Zheng Ping said Q4 revenue will definitely be higher than Q3 and the gross margin will not be worse than the prior quarter, though some intangible‑asset items still need review at year‑end. Looking ahead to next year, continued demand for AI data‑center construction should keep overall operations on a growth trajectory, with AI and data‑center related businesses remaining the main growth drivers. On the global capacity front, the board has approved a large production site in Penang, Malaysia.

Regarding recent inventory buildup and write‑downs, Zheng noted that this year’s operating environment is more complex, affected by customers’ pull‑forward schedules, design and quality specification changes, as well as supplier lead‑time delays and material shortages, which have caused some inventory accumulation. He said this is a short‑term issue and expects the inventory to be cleared gradually starting in Q4; Q3 inventory write‑down provisions were about 1.7% of revenue, and as the issues are resolved and stock is shipped, some of the loss could be recovered.

In addition, rising raw‑material costs have lifted Delta’s material expenses by roughly 2% year‑to‑date. The company is already negotiating price adjustments with customers, with some price changes expected to be reflected in Q4 and others pushed to the first quarter of next year.

On the AI side, Zheng said AI‑related businesses now account for about half of total revenue, covering power supplies, thermal management, components and ICT. Within the Power Solutions Business Group (PSBG), AI‑related revenue is about 25% of that segment. Liquid‑cooling revenue was about NT$25 billion in the first three quarters, roughly 13% of total revenue, and the full‑year share is expected to stay around 13%. He expects the same growth trend to continue next year.

Delta stated that AI data‑center construction has been a primary growth engine in recent years. Based on revenue and cash‑flow growth of large AI players, demand durability is better than expected, with hyperscalers and emerging cloud providers still supporting capex for data centers. The company estimates the four major hyperscalers will spend over US$700 billion on capex this year, and global data‑center capex could reach US$1.2‑1.5 trillion next year, with long‑term build‑out extending to 2030.

However, while AI demand is clear, Zheng warned that supply‑chain revenue growth may not be smooth. In the short term, material shortages, power supply constraints, talent gaps and local government approvals could cause data‑center build‑out schedules to accelerate or delay, creating shipment timing volatility. He added that rapid growth in semiconductor and passive‑component demand is outpacing some suppliers’ capacity to keep up.

He also highlighted the growing power‑shortage issue for data centers, projecting that global data‑center electricity consumption could double by 2030. Besides accelerating power‑plant construction, options such as gas‑fired generation, small‑scale nuclear and solid‑oxide fuel cells (SOFC) could help meet demand. Delta’s SOFC is slated for mass production next year, and its high‑voltage DC power architecture has begun shipping ±400 V units in Q3, with 800 V DC slated for continued rollout next year.

Regarding the large Malaysian production site, Zheng explained that after evaluating several locations, Penang was chosen for its engineering talent pool and favorable industrial environment, which will support an automated factory and later enable process R&D and R&D center expansion. The goal is for the Penang plant’s capacity to eventually match Thailand’s, though not immediately; the target is to reach a comparable scale within five years, with actual progress dependent on overall market growth.

items.title: 德微第3季獲利1.27億元年增逾倍 前3季EPS達5.91元
items.title_en: Dewei Reports Q3 Profit of NT$127 million, More Than Doubling YoY; FY Q1‑Q3 EPS Reaches NT$5.91
paras: 功率半導體廠德微科技(3675-TW)今(29)日公告2026年第三季財務報告，合併營收9.08億元，季增13.37%、年增32.46%；毛利率40.40%，稅後純益1.27億元，季增20.01%，較去年同期翻倍成長，每股純益(EPS)2.4元。前三季累計合併營收23.94億元，年增22.5%，稅後純益3.14億元，累計EPS達5.91元。
德微表示，今年受惠全球供應鏈重組，客戶訂單成長強勁，自第二季起出貨逐步增加，第三季動能進一步升溫。其中，歐美大廠MOSFET訂單挹注，以及AI相關應用的800V高耐壓產品穩健出貨，推升本季營收。
為因應訂單增加與產品規格升級，德微已陸續推進桃園封測廠及子公司亞昕科技晶圓廠的去瓶頸化與產線升級，擴充產能、改善生產效率，提升訂單承接與交付能力。同時，亞昕科技亦投入8KW TVS、650V及1200V MOSFET等產品與技術平台開發，將逐步貢獻營收。
德微指出，公司持續推動IDM布局，透過晶圓設計、製程開發與封裝測試能力的累積，將終端應用需求導入產品開發，並由封裝測試結果回饋前端設計與製程優化。憑藉高耐壓、高效率及高可靠度產品的開發經驗與技術堆疊，公司可在既有技術平台上延伸產品規格，提升開發效率與客製化能力，拓展中高階應用。
展望後市，德微將深化亞昕晶圓設計製造、德微封裝測試及喜可士自有品牌銷售的垂直整合體系，透過集團上中下游協作，有效調度產能、穩定供貨，配合國際客戶供應來源多元化的布局，爭取車用、工控及AI相關應用領域之新客戶與專案合作，鞏固中長期成長利基。
paras_en: Dewei Technology (3675‑TW) announced its 2026 third‑quarter financial results today (29th), reporting consolidated revenue of NT$9.08 billion, up 13.37% sequentially and 32.46% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 40.40%, and net profit after tax was NT$1.27 billion, up 20.01% sequentially and more than double the same quarter last year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$2.40. For the first three quarters, cumulative consolidated revenue reached NT$23.94 billion, a 22.5% increase year‑over‑year, net profit after tax was NT$3.14 billion, and cumulative EPS was NT$5.91.

Dewei said that this year it benefited from the global supply‑chain reshuffle, with strong growth in customer orders. Shipments began to rise gradually from the second quarter and the momentum further heated up in the third quarter. In particular, orders from major MOSFET customers in Europe and the United States, as well as steady shipments of 800 V high‑voltage AI‑related products, boosted this quarter’s revenue.

To cope with the increase in orders and the upgrade of product specifications, Dewei has been advancing the de‑bottlenecking and line upgrades at its Taoyuan packaging and testing plant and its subsidiary Yaxin Technology wafer fab, expanding capacity and improving production efficiency to enhance order intake and delivery capability. At the same time, Yaxin Technology is investing in the development of 8 kW TVS, 650 V and 1,200 V MOSFET products and technology platforms, which will gradually contribute to revenue.

Dewei noted that the company continues to push its IDM (integrated device manufacturing) strategy, leveraging accumulated wafer design, process development and packaging‑testing capabilities to feed end‑application demands into product development, and using packaging‑test results to feed back into front‑end design and process optimization. With its experience and technology stack in high‑voltage, high‑efficiency and high‑reliability products, the company can extend product specifications on existing platforms, improve development efficiency and customization, and expand into mid‑to‑high‑end applications.

Looking ahead, Dewei will deepen the vertically integrated system that includes Yaxin wafer design and manufacturing, Dewei packaging and testing, and its own brand sales under the Xike Si brand. Through upstream‑midstream‑downstream collaboration within the group, it can effectively allocate capacity, stabilize supply, and align with international customers’ diversified sourcing strategies, seeking new customers and project collaborations in automotive, industrial control and AI‑related applications, thereby consolidating its medium‑ to long‑term growth niche.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI砸錢何時回本？Alphabet財報失色、通膨又施壓 主要指數開低
paras: 美股周四(29日)開盤走低，Alphabet與開拓重工財報未能滿足市場期待，再度引發投資人對人工智慧(AI)龐大支出與投資回報的疑慮，科技股承壓，標普500指數面臨終結連三日漲勢的壓力。
聯準會(Fed)前一日維持利率不變後，最新公布的美國9月PCE通膨年增率升至3.6%，市場同步評估物價壓力對年底利率走向的影響。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌逾200點或近0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近480點或近1.8%，標普 500 指數跌近0.6%，費城半導體指數跌近2.3%，台積電ADR跌近1.4%。
全球科技股漲勢受挫，Alphabet與三星電子財報表現不如預期，再度引發市場對人工智慧(AI)龐大投資能否帶來足夠回報的疑慮。周四美股盤前，那斯達克100指數期貨下跌1.3%，預示指數可能終結連三日漲勢；標普500指數期貨下跌0.5%，美國第三季經濟成長優於預期，也未能扭轉跌勢。
美債則在聯準會(Fed)周三維持利率不變後持穩，2年期美債殖利率徘徊於4.7%，10年期約5%。市場接下來關注歐洲央行與日本央行決策，兩者均料按兵不動。

AI支出回報受檢驗 科技與設備股承壓

Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)盤前重挫11%，營收不如預期，令投資人擔憂，即使投入數千億美元發展AI，仍難阻止競爭對手侵蝕核心業務。三星電子(005930-KR)則下跌4.1%，晶片部門獲利未達預期、資本支出增加，加上未推出新的股東回饋計畫，令市場失望。
Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston表示，市場並非質疑Alphabet的AI機會，而是在建設成本持續壓抑現金流之際，重新衡量應給予多少價值；投資人對支出、利潤率與現金創造能力不如預期的容忍度正降低。
微軟(MSFT-US)原因雲端銷售強勁而盤前上漲3.7%，但啟動2017年以來首筆投資等級債券發行後，回吐大部分漲幅。ServiceNow(NOW-US)與Fortinet(FTNT-US)財報失色，也加深軟體業前景疑慮，後者暴跌27%。
AI資料中心電力設備供應商開拓重工(CAT-US)預估第四季營收僅溫和成長，股價重挫10%。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周四盤後及蘋果(AAPL-US)下周公布的財報，將進一步考驗市場信心。

歐股走揚油價回落 通膨數據牽動美債

歐洲Stoxx600指數上漲0.6%，能源與電信股漲勢抵銷銀行股下跌。殼牌(SHEL-US)宣布大幅增加庫藏股規模後走高，荷蘭國際集團(ING-US)則因獲利不如預期、成本與呆帳準備增加而下跌，並宣布裁減約400人。
油價隨中東外交斡旋進展回落，市場評估相關努力能否避免美國恢復對伊朗軍事打擊，布蘭特原油下跌1%至每桶114.10美元。
Fed周三以10比2維持利率不變後，投資人也關注美國核心個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數。《彭博》策略師Ven Ram指出，2年期美債殖利率過去一個月已下降約25個基點，若通膨高於預期，顯示Fed抑制物價仍有漫長道路，可能引發短天期美債獲利了結賣壓。
