items.title: 〈財報〉業績超標股價卻崩了！開拓重工盤前跌逾10% 市場在怕什麼？
items.title_en: Earnings Beat Yet Stock Crashes: Caterpillar Falls Over 10% Pre‑Market, What’s the Market Worried About?
paras: 有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的開拓重工(CAT-US)周四(29日)美股盤前公布2026會計年度第三季(截至9月30日)財報，營收與調整後每股純益均優於市場預期，未交付訂單也創新高，但公司維持全年營收成長展望，未能化解投資人對人工智慧(AI)基礎建設熱潮能否延續的疑慮，股價盤前一度重挫逾10%。
根據財報，開拓重工第三季營收年增17%至206.8億美元，高於LSEG調查預估的205.5億美元；調整後每股純益由去年同期4.95美元升至7.20美元，優於預估的7.08美元。營業利益率達20.6%，較去年同期提高約3個百分點，也高於市場預期。
截稿前，開拓重工(CAT-US)周四盤前股價下跌9.59%，每股暫報645.00美元。

訂單創高仍難過關 全年展望未上修成焦點

開拓重工第三季未交付訂單總額達781億美元，較第二季增加60億美元，年增382億美元，雖創歷史新高，但增加速度較今年稍早放緩。
公司維持2026年營收成長百分之十幾中段至高段的預測，分析師則預期約18%，接近公司預測區間高端。開拓重工另預估，第四季營收較去年同期僅「溫和」成長，讓期待更強勁展望的投資人失望。
獲利超標的組成也受到檢視。第三季營業利益包含1.28億美元與《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA)關稅退還相關的利益，公司全年關稅成本預估則維持約22億美元。
Oppenheimer分析師Kristen Owen指出，儘管各事業普遍成長，這次獲利超標的品質仍讓投資人看見開拓重工的弱點，顯示市場不只看當季數字，也在檢驗後續成長力道。

能源業務成最大支柱 AI建設面臨政策與融資壓力

開拓重工以黃色挖土機、推土機與大型礦用卡車聞名，如今製造發電機、大型引擎與燃氣渦輪的動力與能源事業，已成為營收最大的業務。第三季該部門營收年增18%至89億美元，採礦與營建業務也分別成長15%及18%。
受惠資料中心用電需求，公司正推動多年擴產計畫，提高大型引擎與燃氣渦輪產能，今年稍早也調高發電設備銷售目標。不過，市場對AI投資回報的疑慮，加上利率攀升推高融資成本，已使相關供應鏈承壓。
資料中心的政治阻力也在增加。美國期中選舉前，耗電、用水及電費上漲疑慮成為競選議題，紐約州等地限制新開發案，增添建設地點與啟用時程的不確定性。
Raymond James分析師Tim Thein則指出，儘管監管與信用風險升溫，經銷商回饋仍顯示訂單需求強勁，尤其大型燃氣引擎交期仍處歷史偏長水準。
截至周三收盤，開拓重工股價已較6月高點下跌約33%。這次財報後再遭拋售，反映即使營運持續成長，市場仍期待更明確的證據，證明AI基建需求足以支撐未來業績。
paras_en: Caterpillar (CAT-US), dubbed the “canary of the economy,” released its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter results (ended September 30) in pre‑market trading on Thursday the 29th. Revenue and adjusted EPS both topped expectations and undelivered orders hit a record high, but the company kept its full‑year revenue outlook unchanged, failing to allay investors’ doubts about whether the AI infrastructure boom can be sustained, and the stock plunged more than 10% in pre‑market trading.

According to the filing, third‑quarter revenue rose 17% year‑over‑year to $20.68 billion, beating LSEG’s forecast of $20.55 billion. Adjusted earnings per share climbed from $4.95 a year ago to $7.20, ahead of the $7.08 estimate. Operating margin hit 20.6%, about three percentage points higher than a year ago and above market expectations.
Just before the article was filed, Caterpillar’s pre‑market share price was down 9.59%, reporting a temporary price of $645.00 per share.

Despite record‑high undelivered orders, the company still struggled to clear the hurdle, and its unchanged full‑year outlook became the focus. Caterpillar’s undelivered order backlog for the quarter reached $78.1 billion, up $6 billion from the prior quarter and $38.2 billion year‑over‑year, a historic high though the growth rate has slowed slightly from earlier in the year.

The firm kept its 2026 revenue growth forecast in the mid‑to‑high teens percent range, while analysts expect roughly 18%, near the top of the company’s own range. Caterpillar also warned that fourth‑quarter revenue would only grow “moderately” versus the same period last year, disappointing investors hoping for a stronger outlook.

The composition of the earnings beat also drew scrutiny. The quarter’s operating profit included a $128 million benefit related to refunds under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), and the company continues to estimate full‑year tariff costs at about $2.2 billion.

Oppenheimer analyst Kristen Owen noted that although most business segments grew, the quality of this earnings beat revealed Caterpillar’s weaknesses, showing that the market is looking beyond the headline numbers to assess future growth momentum.

Energy remains Caterpillar’s biggest pillar, while AI construction faces policy and financing pressure. Known for its yellow excavators, bulldozers and large mining trucks, the company’s power and energy segment—making generators, large engines and gas turbines—has become its largest revenue source. That segment’s revenue grew 18% year‑over‑year to $8.9 billion in the quarter, with mining and construction businesses up 15% and 18% respectively.

Benefiting from data‑center power demand, the company is pushing a multi‑year capacity‑expansion plan to boost large‑engine and gas‑turbine output and earlier this year raised its sales target for power‑generation equipment. However, market concerns over AI investment returns, coupled with rising interest rates that increase financing costs, are putting pressure on the related supply chain.

Political resistance to data‑center expansion is also rising. Ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, concerns about electricity, water usage and higher utility bills have become campaign issues, and states such as New York are restricting new developments, adding uncertainty to construction sites and project timelines.

Raymond James analyst Tim Thein pointed out that despite heightened regulatory and credit risks, dealer feedback still shows strong order demand, especially as delivery times for large gas engines remain historically long.

By Wednesday’s close, Caterpillar’s share price had fallen about 33% from its June high. The post‑earnings sell‑off underscores that even with continued operational growth, the market still wants clearer evidence that AI infrastructure demand is robust enough to support future performance.

items.title: 企業投資與消費強勁 美國第三季GDP年化成長率達3.4% 優於預期
items.title_en: Strong Corporate Investment and Consumer Spending Drive US Q3 GDP Annualized Growth to 3.4%, Beating Expectations
paras: 根據美國經濟分析局(BEA)與商務部周四(29日)發布的初估數據，美國第三季GDP經季節調整後以年率計算達 3.4%，顯著高於第二季的 2.2%，並優於彭博調查與道瓊共識預期的 3.2%，創下一年來最快經濟擴張速度。
在推動成長的動力方面，商務部報告指出，熱絡的企業投資與展現韌性的家庭支出為兩大核心主軸。受到人工智慧(AI)相關投資熱潮帶動，設備支出對 GDP 的貢獻創下 2011 年以來新高(排除疫情後復甦期)。同時，家庭消費支出年化成長率達 3.8%，高於預期的 3.4%，連續兩季保持強勁動能。
儘管經濟擴張亮眼，商務部數據顯示通膨壓力依然升溫。9 月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數月增 0.5%，創下6個月來最大增幅，年增率則為 3.6%。扣除食品與能源的核心 PCE 物價指數月增 0.3%、年增 3.1%，均符合道瓊共識預期。
報告發布的前一天，聯準會剛剛投票決定將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%的區間內。儘管通膨數據處於高位，但聯準會官員堅稱，他們有時間在做出下一步決策前，先對後續出爐的數據進行評估。
聯準會主席凱文華許(Kevin Warsh)表示：「我們即將面臨的這段時期，資訊量非常豐富。全球正在發生許多事情，我和我的同事們都非常關注這些動態。」
這份報告是下周期中選舉前最後一份關鍵經濟體檢表。整體數據展現出美國經濟的韌性與復甦動能，優於預期的表現，將進一步提振市場與政策制定者對經濟前景的信心。
paras_en: According to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and the Commerce Department’s preliminary estimates released on Thursday (the 29th), seasonally adjusted U.S. third‑quarter GDP grew at an annualized rate of 3.4%, markedly higher than the 2.2% recorded in the second quarter and above the Bloomberg survey and Dow Jones consensus forecast of 3.2%, marking the fastest expansion in a year.

In terms of growth drivers, the Commerce Department report highlighted vigorous corporate investment and resilient household spending as the two core pillars. Fueled by a wave of AI‑related investment, equipment spending’s contribution to GDP hit a post‑pandemic high not seen since 2011. At the same time, household consumption grew at an annualized 3.8%, outpacing the 3.4% forecast and maintaining strong momentum for a second consecutive quarter.

Despite the impressive expansion, the Commerce Department data showed inflationary pressure remains elevated. The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, the largest increase in six months, with an annual rise of 3.6%. The core PCE price index, which excludes food and energy, increased 0.3% month‑over‑month and 3.1% year‑over‑year, both in line with Dow Jones consensus expectations.

The day before the report’s release, the Federal Reserve had just voted to keep the target federal funds rate in the 3.75%‑4% range. Although inflation data remain high, Fed officials said they have time to assess upcoming data before making the next policy move.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said, “We are entering a period that is information‑rich. A lot is happening globally, and my colleagues and I are closely monitoring these dynamics.”

This report is the last key economic health check before the mid‑term elections next week. The overall data demonstrate the resilience and recovery momentum of the U.S. economy, outperforming expectations and likely to further boost market and policymaker confidence in the economic outlook.

items.title: 通膨又來施壓！美國9月PCE年增3.6% Fed12月升息機率逾八成
items.title_en: Inflation Returns to Pressure! US September PCE Up 3.6% YoY, Fed's December Rate Hike Odds Over 80%
paras: 美國9月通膨加速，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率升至3.6%，扣除食品與能源的核心PCE年增率也攀至3.1%，強化市場對聯準會(Fed)12月升息的預期。儘管名目消費支出持續增加，扣除物價因素後卻停滯，顯示家庭支出成長受到漲價推動，實際消費動能轉弱。
美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)周四(29日)公布，9月PCE物價指數月增0.5%，高於8月的0.3%，符合經濟學家預期；年增率則由8月的3.4%升至3.6%，為5月以來最高。汽油與其他商品價格上漲，是推升通膨的重要因素。
扣除波動較大的食品與能源後，9月核心PCE月增0.3%，符合預期；8月增幅則由原估0.2%上修至0.3%。核心PCE年增率由8月的3.0%升至3.1%，同樣符合市場預估，但仍明顯高於Fed的2%通膨目標。
價格壓力也不僅限於能源。排除住房的服務價格指標，也就是市場關注的「超級核心」PCE，年增率升至2024年12月以來最高，顯示服務業通膨仍具黏著性，增加Fed防止漲價壓力擴散的挑戰。
Fed周三維持基準利率於3.75%至4.00%，並在聲明中承認通膨「仍然偏高」。主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在記者會表示，能源及相關價格最近幾周再度上漲，Fed的任務是確保部分產業的相對價格變動，不會擴散至整體經濟，同時維持通膨預期穩定。
根據芝商所FedWatch工具，金融市場預估Fed在12月升息的機率約為83.3%。最新PCE數據雖未超出預期，但整體與核心通膨同步走高，支持經濟學家對年底再度升息的判斷。
消費方面，占美國經濟活動逾三分之二的個人消費支出，9月月增0.5%，低於市場預估的0.6%，也較8月的0.9%放緩。扣除通膨後，實質消費支出與前月持平，意味消費以較弱的成長動能邁入第四季。
同月個人所得僅增加0.2%，低於預期的0.5%，增幅也落後消費支出，個人儲蓄率因而降至2022年10月以來最低。物價上漲、所得增幅有限與儲蓄緩衝縮小，凸顯美國家庭面臨的壓力。
同日公布的第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初估顯示，美國經濟經季節調整後換算成年率成長3.4%，消費支出以相同口徑成長3.8%。不過，9月實質消費停滯，也提醒市場，第三季整體成長強勁，未必代表季末需求同樣穩健。
paras_en: US September inflation accelerated, with the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rising 3.6% year‑over‑year and the core PCE (excluding food and energy) climbing to 3.1%, bolstering market expectations of a Fed rate hike in December. Although nominal consumer spending kept rising, real spending stalled after stripping out price effects, indicating that household spending growth was driven by higher prices and that underlying consumption momentum is weakening.

The US Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) released on Thursday the September PCE data, showing a 0.5% monthly increase, up from 0.3% in August and in line with economists’ forecasts; the annual rate rose from 3.4% in August to 3.6%, the highest since May. Higher gasoline and other commodity prices were key drivers of the inflation rise.

Excluding the more volatile food and energy components, September core PCE rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, matching expectations; August’s increase was revised up from an initial 0.2% to 0.3%. The core PCE annual rate rose from 3.0% in August to 3.1%, also in line with market estimates but still well above the Fed’s 2% inflation target.

Price pressures are not limited to energy. The services‑excluding‑housing price index, often called the “super‑core” PCE that markets watch, posted its highest annual growth since December 2024, showing that service‑sector inflation remains sticky and adding to the Fed’s challenge of preventing price pressures from spreading.

The Fed kept its target rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00% on Wednesday and acknowledged in its statement that inflation is “still too high.” Chair Kevin Warsh told reporters that energy and related prices have risen again in recent weeks, and the Fed’s job is to ensure that price movements in certain sectors do not spill over to the broader economy while keeping inflation expectations anchored.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, financial markets estimate an about 83.3% probability that the Fed will raise rates in December. Although the latest PCE numbers did not exceed expectations, the simultaneous rise in headline and core inflation supports economists’ view that another rate hike is likely at year‑end.

On the consumption side, personal consumption expenditures – which account for more than two‑thirds of US economic activity – grew 0.5% in September, below the market forecast of 0.6% and slower than August’s 0.9% gain. After stripping out inflation, real consumption was flat versus the prior month, meaning spending entered the fourth quarter with weaker growth momentum.

Personal income in the same month rose only 0.2%, well under the 0.5% expected, lagging behind consumption growth and pushing the personal savings rate down to its lowest level since October 2022. Rising prices, modest income gains and a shrinking savings buffer highlight the pressure on US households.

The third‑quarter GDP advance, released the same day, showed a seasonally adjusted annualized growth rate of 3.4% for the economy, with consumption growing at the same 3.8% pace. However, the stagnation of real consumption in September reminds markets that strong overall Q3 growth does not necessarily imply equally robust demand at the end of the quarter.

items.title: 從網路泡沫到金融危機 這項「幾乎沒錯過」的指標再讓市場戒備？
items.title_en: From the Dot‑Com Bubble to the Financial Crisis: This ‘Almost‑Missed’ Indicator Raises Market Vigilance Again?
paras: 美股市場在經歷創紀錄的升勢後近期出現震盪回檔，標普 500 指數、道瓊指數與那斯達克指數分別自今年高點下挫約 2%、3% 及 5%。同時，反映市場情緒的「恐慌與貪婪指數」落入 32，處於「恐慌」區間，顯示投資人焦慮情緒升溫。
《The Motley Fool》財經分析師Katie Brockman撰文指出，雖然股市修正終將發生，但透過歷史上精準度極高的經濟衰退指標——殖利率曲線倒掛，可為投資人提供客觀的市場觀測依據，儘管現在還未發生，但仍應密切觀察。

最著名及可靠的衰退指標

Brockman表示，當長期利率低於短期利率時，殖利率曲線就會倒掛，自1970年代以來，幾乎每一次經濟衰退之前都出現了殖利率曲線倒掛的現象。其中，市場最密切追蹤的是「10 年期與 2 年期美債殖利率利差」。
以下是三次倒掛後的股市表現：

網路泡沫：2000 年 2 月此利差發生倒掛，僅一個月後股市便正式步入熊市。
全球金融危機：2006 年殖利率曲線再度倒掛，隨後美國於 2007 年底爆發大衰退。
2022 年市場震盪：2022 年殖利率曲線再次倒掛，儘管技術上未界定為經濟衰退，但在高通膨與美國聯準會連續升息衝擊下，股市仍跌入熊市。


然而，Brockman強調，殖利率曲線雖然準確，也無法精確預測衰退何時開始、持續多久或嚴峻程度為何。
針對當前情勢，Brockman表示，殖利率曲線自 2024 年以來已結束倒掛，目前呈現向下傾斜的型態。然而，考量到聯準會未來仍保有升息選項，殖利率曲線未來的走向仍具高度不確定性。

投資應對建議

面對難以避免的市場景氣循環，Brockman認為與其焦慮於預測衰退時機，不如專注於優化投資組合。她建議投資人應選股聚焦基本面，佈局具備持久競爭優勢與健康財務狀況的優質企業，這是股票能否在經歷衰退後迅速反彈的關鍵分水嶺。
此外，應著眼長期總報酬。歷史數據顯示，自 2000 年 1 月至今，標普 500 指數儘管歷經多次重大熊市，累計漲幅仍超過 750%。
Brockman總結，堅持持有高基本面品質的股票，將能幫助投資人的投資組合順利渡過極端波動，並在長期取得正向回報。
paras_en: U.S. equity markets, after a record‑setting rally, have recently entered a volatile pullback, with the S&P 500, Dow Jones and Nasdaq down about 2%, 3% and 5% from their year‑highs. At the same time, the “Fear & Greed Index” fell to 32, placing it in the “fear” zone and indicating rising investor anxiety.

The Motley Fool analyst Katie Brockman wrote that while a market correction is inevitable, the historically precise recession gauge—the yield‑curve inversion—can give investors an objective market outlook. Although a reversal hasn’t occurred yet, it warrants close monitoring.

The most famous and reliable recession signal, Brockman notes, is when long‑term rates fall below short‑term rates, causing the yield curve to invert. Since the 1970s, an inversion has preceded almost every recession, with market participants watching the spread between the 10‑year and 2‑year U.S. Treasury yields most closely.
The article lists stock‑market performance after three past inversions:

During the dot‑com bubble, the 10‑year/2‑year spread inverted in February 2000, and a month later the market officially entered a bear phase. The global financial crisis saw another inversion in 2006, followed by the U.S. Great Recession at the end of 2007. In 2022 the curve inverted again; while not technically a recession, high inflation and successive Fed rate hikes still pushed equities into bear‑market territory.
Brockman cautions that, although the yield curve is accurate, it cannot pinpoint exactly when a recession will start, how long it will last, or how severe it will be.

Regarding the current environment, Brockman says the yield curve ended its inversion in 2024 and now slopes downward. Yet, because the Fed still retains the option to raise rates, the future shape of the curve remains highly uncertain.

Investment advice: Facing inevitable economic cycles, Brockman argues that instead of obsessing over timing a recession, investors should focus on optimizing portfolios. She recommends selecting stocks with strong fundamentals—companies with durable competitive advantages and solid balance sheets—as the key differentiator for rapid post‑recession rebounds.
She adds that a long‑term total‑return perspective is essential. Historical data show that from January 2000 to today, the S&P 500 has risen over 750% despite multiple major bear markets.

items.title: 一塊基板決定算力生死：先進封裝悄悄綁架AI產業　晶片做得出卻「裝不下」怎麼辦？
items.title_en: A Single Substrate Decides Computing Power: Advanced Packaging Quietly Hijacks the AI Industry, Chips Can Be Made but “Cannot Be Packed” – What to Do?
paras: AI晶片的競爭，正從「誰能把電晶體做小」轉向「誰能把更多晶片封得進同一塊底座」。隨著大模型參數規模與推理複雜度飆升，單顆GPU已無法獨立扛起算力與記憶體頻寬需求，Chiplet(小晶片)與HBM被迫塞進同一先進封裝，封裝尺寸連十年膨脹，逐步逼近光刻機單次曝光的「光罩極限」。
根據集邦諮詢(TrendForce)最新報告指出，儘管英特爾以EMIB-T方案積極爭取AI晶片客戶，但台積電CoWoS-L憑藉技術成熟度與良率優勢，預計到2028年仍將是AI晶片主流先進封裝方案；先進封裝因此正式成為算力競爭的戰略基礎設施。
先進製程微縮成本驟增，業界轉而靠異質整合延續性能成長。以輝達Rubin平台為例，單顆GPU配HBM4、可提供288GB顯存與22TB/s頻寬；超微MI455X則由8個運算晶片組成。運算單片與HBM數量同步增加，壓力直接傳導到封裝環節。
台積電CoWoS矽中介層面積，已從2016年約1.5倍光罩(约1287mm²)擴至目前3.3倍(约2831mm²)，Blackwell世代約3.3倍光罩，Rubin預計達4倍，台積電並規劃2026年推進到5.5倍、約4719mm²，2028年備妥9.5倍、2029年挑戰14倍以上規格。
台積電CoWoS家族分S、R、L三條路線。CoWoS-S採整片矽中介層；CoWoS-R改用重佈線層(RDL)；CoWoS-L則在RDL中嵌入「局部矽互連(LSI)」小晶片，只在需要高密互連的區域使用矽橋，其餘由RDL負責供電與訊號扇出。這種「局部高密度＋大面積擴展」架構，兼顧互連密度與成本，成為超大AI晶片首選。
目前，輝達與超微AI加速器已採用CoWoS-L；Meta的MTIA 400預計2026年量產，亞馬遜AWS、微軟自研ASIC可望2027年導入。台積電並已將5.5倍光罩CoWoS-L推向規模量產，多家AI客戶產品良率穩定超過98%，部分達99%。
英特爾則不走大面積矽中介層路線，而以EMIB(嵌入式多晶片互連橋)在局部嵌入矽橋。新一代EMIB-T更導入矽通孔(TSV)，讓電流垂直穿橋直送晶片，解決高功耗AI晶片的供電瓶頸。
英特爾在ECTC 2026展示的關鍵數據包括首層互連凸點間距縮至25微米、封裝尺寸達120×120mm、單封裝整合超過9倍光罩面積運算與儲存矽內容，HBM4e速率突破12Gb/s、UCIe介面達64Gb/s。由於省去昂貴大矽中介層，EMIB-T具成本結構優勢，集邦諮詢預估谷歌可望2027年導入EMIB-T，AWS則在測試階段。
隨著封裝持續放大，訊號完整性、電源完整性、散熱、良率與成本同步施壓。AI加速器高功耗下，晶片橫向鋪開仍受物理空間限制；單一封裝內多顆運算Die、HBM與互連結構任一環節失效，即拖累整體良率。台積電CoWoS量產十年、良率站穩九成以上，成為客戶不敢輕易換軌的關鍵。
3D堆疊技術如台積電SoIC雖能再提升單位面積密度，但需多次流片與多套光罩，散熱與供電更難解，成本與良率短期難匹配大規模AI訓練晶片需求，因此2.5D在現階段仍是主流。
集邦諮詢研判指出，未來幾年AI晶片封裝競爭將圍繞「更大尺寸、更高互連密度」展開，但勝負不再只看面積，而是系統級協同設計能力——從晶片架構、封裝佈局到散熱供電一起定義。
對台積電而言，CoWoS-L鎖定高階市場與產能話語權；對英特爾而言，EMIB-T是代工業務翻身的關鍵變量。當光罩極限被一步步推開，AI晶片的下一場戰爭，不在晶圓廠的曝光機，而在封裝線上的那塊「底座」。
paras_en: The competition for AI chips is shifting from “who can make transistors smaller” to “who can fit more chips onto the same substrate.” As model parameter sizes and inference complexity soar, a single GPU can no longer independently meet the compute and memory bandwidth demands, forcing chiplets and HBM to be packed into the same advanced package. Package sizes have expanded tenfold over the past decade, gradually approaching the lithography tool’s single‑exposure “mask limit.”

According to a recent TrendForce report, although Intel is aggressively courting AI chip customers with its EMIB‑T solution, TSMC’s CoWoS‑L—thanks to mature technology and yield advantages—will remain the mainstream advanced packaging solution for AI chips through 2028. Advanced packaging has thus become the strategic infrastructure for compute competition.

Advanced process node shrinkage costs have spiked, so the industry has turned to heterogeneous integration to sustain performance growth. For example, NVIDIA’s Rubin platform pairs a single GPU with HBM4, offering 288 GB of VRAM and 22 TB/s bandwidth; AMD’s MI455X consists of eight compute dies. The number of compute dies and HBM units increases in tandem, directly stressing the packaging stage.

TSMC’s CoWoS silicon interposer area has grown from about 1.5× the mask (≈1,287 mm²) in 2016 to 3.3× (≈2,831 mm²) today. The Blackwell generation is about 3.3×, Rubin is expected to reach 4×, and TSMC plans to push to 5.5× (≈4,719 mm²) in 2026, 9.5× in 2028, and challenge over 14× in 2029.

TSMC’s CoWoS family has three routes: CoWoS‑S uses a full‑die silicon interposer; CoWoS‑R replaces it with a redistribution layer (RDL); CoWoS‑L embeds a “local silicon interconnect (LSI)” chip within the RDL, using silicon bridges only where high‑density interconnect is needed, while the RDL handles power and signal fan‑out. This “local high‑density + large‑area expansion” architecture balances interconnect density and cost, making it the preferred choice for ultra‑large AI chips.

Currently, NVIDIA and AMD AI accelerators use CoWoS‑L; Meta’s MTIA‑400 is slated for 2026 mass production, and Amazon AWS and Microsoft’s in‑house ASICs are expected to adopt it in 2027. TSMC has already scaled the 5.5× mask CoWoS‑L to mass production, with many AI customers reporting yields above 98%, some reaching 99%.

Intel does not pursue a large‑area silicon interposer but instead embeds silicon bridges locally with EMIB (Embedded Multi‑Chip Interconnect Bridge). The next‑generation EMIB‑T incorporates through‑silicon vias (TSVs), allowing current to pass vertically through the bridge directly to the chip, addressing the power bottleneck of high‑power AI chips.

Intel’s key data presented at ECTC 2026 include a first‑layer interconnect pitch reduced to 25 µm, a package size of 120 × 120 mm, and a single package integrating more than 9× the mask area of compute and storage silicon. HBM4e rates exceed 12 Gb/s, and the UCIe interface reaches 64 Gb/s. By eliminating the expensive large silicon interposer, EMIB‑T offers a cost advantage; TrendForce estimates Google could adopt EMIB‑T in 2027, while AWS is still in testing.

As packaging continues to scale, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal management, yield, and cost all exert simultaneous pressure. Under high‑power AI acceleration, horizontally spreading chips remains limited by physical space; any failure in the multiple compute dies, HBM, or interconnect structure within a single package drags down overall yield. TSMC’s CoWoS has maintained yields above 90% over ten years of mass production, making customers reluctant to switch tracks.

3D stacking technologies such as TSMC’s SoIC can further increase area density, but they require multiple lithography steps and mask sets, making thermal and power delivery more difficult; cost and yield in the short term cannot match the large‑scale AI training chip demand, so 2.5D remains mainstream for now.

TrendForce predicts that in the coming years, AI chip packaging competition will focus on “larger size, higher interconnect density,” but the outcome will no longer be judged solely on area; it will hinge on system‑level collaborative design capability—from chip architecture and package layout to thermal and power delivery.

For TSMC, CoWoS‑L secures high‑end market and production capacity leverage; for Intel, EMIB‑T is the key variable for turning around its foundry business. As the mask limit is gradually pushed, the next battle for AI chips will not be fought on the lithography tool’s exposure machine but on the “substrate” in the packaging line.

items.title: Anthropic IPO即將登場：投資人必看的5大關鍵數據
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Set to Launch: 5 Key Data Points Investors Must See
paras: 人工智慧(AI)巨頭 Anthropic 已正式遞交首次公開發行(IPO)申請，最快可能於下個月上市，市場預估其公開上市規模有望成為史上最大，甚至超越 SpaceX。
然而，在決定是否搶先認購前，理財專欄作家兼註冊會計師(CPA)David Jagielski 提醒，投資人應先深入評估以下 5 大關鍵財務數據，以全面掌握 Anthropic 的營運現況與潛在風險。
一、前六個月營收達 163 億美元
Anthropic 在 2026 年前兩季累計營收達 163 億美元，相較去年同期大幅成長 1,300%。以全年換算的運行率(run rate)(營運跑率)約為 320 億美元計算，若以市場傳出的 2 兆美元估值推算，相當於投資人需支付超過 60 倍營收的高額溢價。
二、前兩季營業虧損為 6.93 億美元
雖然該公司因公允價值變動等非營運項目，在今年前兩季帳面出現高達 807 億美元的淨虧損，但更能反映本業營運狀況的「營業虧損」為 6.93 億美元，比起去年同期的 21 億美元虧損已有所改善。不過Jagielski 指出，為了擴大營運規模並在市場競爭中保持領先，公司仍須激進地擴大支出，短期內能否實現獲利仍未可知。
三、約 20% 營收來自僅僅兩家客戶
Anthropic 約有五分之一的營收集中於兩家客戶，且公司坦言在可預見的未來客戶數量依然有限。這意味著其業務成長高度綁定於少數科技巨頭的 AI 投資意願，一旦主要客戶縮減資本支出，將直接衝擊其成長動力。
四、上半年算力支出高達近 90 億美元
算力與基礎建設是 Anthropic 最龐大的費用項目，2026 年上半年支出已達 89 億美元，僅半年時間就超過去年(2025 年)全年的 73 億美元總和。
五、未來算力需求恐高達 7,500 億美元
為維持長期業務成長，Anthropic 預估未來在算力容量上的支出可能高達 7,500 億美元。Jagielski 警告，在利率走升的市場環境下，一家尚未獲利的公司需要如此快速且大規模地籌措資金，可能引發嚴重的現金消耗(cash burn)，並導致頻繁增資發行新股，大幅稀釋既有股東權益。
Jagielski 強調，在上市初期過早介入該股票具有極高風險。他以 SpaceX 上市後的走勢為例，指出該股在上市頭幾天暴漲後便大幅拉回，即使後續營運保持成長，股價至今仍未重返當時高點。因此，儘管 Anthropic 有機會創下史上最大 IPO 紀錄，他仍建議投資人保持謹慎，不宜在上市初期盲目搶進。
paras_en: AI giant Anthropic has formally filed for an initial public offering (IPO), with the earliest possible listing as soon as next month, and the market estimates its public offering could become the largest ever, potentially surpassing SpaceX.

However, before deciding whether to jump in, financial columnist and CPA David Jagielski warns investors to first evaluate five key financial metrics to fully understand Anthropic's operational status and potential risks.
1. Revenue of $16.3 billion in the first six months

Anthropic posted cumulative revenue of $16.3 billion for the first two quarters of 2026, a massive 1,300% increase year‑over‑year. Using a full‑year run rate of about $32 billion, a market‑talked valuation of $2 trillion would imply investors paying more than 60 times revenue, a steep premium.
2. Operating loss of $693 million in the first two quarters

Although the company recorded a headline net loss of $80.7 billion in the first two quarters due to non‑operating items such as fair‑value adjustments, the operating loss – a clearer indicator of core performance – was $693 million, improved from a $2.1 billion loss a year earlier. Jagielski notes that to scale up and stay ahead in the competitive market, the firm must continue aggressive spending, and profitability in the short term remains uncertain.
3. About 20% of revenue comes from just two customers

Roughly one‑fifth of Anthropic’s revenue is concentrated in two clients, and the company admits that the number of customers will remain limited in the foreseeable future. This ties growth heavily to the AI investment appetite of a few tech giants; any cut‑back by the main customers would directly hit growth momentum.
4. Computing‑capacity spending reached nearly $9 billion in the first half
Compute and infrastructure are Anthropic’s biggest expense items; spending in the first half of 2026 hit $8.9 billion, already exceeding the total $7.3 billion spent in all of 2025.
5. Future compute capacity needs could soar to $750 billion

To sustain long‑term growth, Anthropic projects future spend on compute capacity could climb to $750 billion. Jagielski warns that in a rising‑rate environment, a still‑unprofitable company needing such rapid, massive capital raises could face severe cash burn and frequent equity issuances, heavily diluting existing shareholders.

Jagielski stresses that entering the stock too early after the IPO carries very high risk. Citing SpaceX’s post‑IPO trajectory, he notes the shares surged dramatically in the first days then pulled back sharply, and despite continued operational growth, the price has never returned to those early highs. Consequently, even though Anthropic may set a record‑breaking IPO, he advises investors to remain cautious and avoid blind early‑stage buying.

items.title: 〈財報〉猛健樂賣翻了！禮來大幅上修全年營收展望 盤前股價漲逾4%
items.title_en: Eli Lilly Beats Estimates as Mounjaro Soars; Raises Full-Year Revenue Outlook, Pre-Market Stock Up Over 4%
paras: 禮來(LLY-US)周四(29日)美股盤前公布2026會計年度第三季(截至9月30日)財報，受惠糖尿病藥物猛健樂(Mounjaro)與減重針劑Zepbound需求強勁，營收與調整後每股純益雙雙優於預期，並大幅上修全年營收展望。儘管併購相關費用拖累全年獲利預測，新款口服減重藥Foundayo銷售也未達預期，禮來盤前股價仍一度漲近5%。
根據財報，禮來第三季營收達244億美元，高於LSEG調查預估的226.1億美元；調整後每股純益7.48美元，也超過預估的6.26美元。淨利則由去年同期55.8億美元增至64.5億美元，每股純益從6.21美元升至7.22美元。
截稿前，禮來(LLY)周四盤前股價上漲4.25%，每股暫報1,343.00美元。

全年營收展望上修 併購費用壓低獲利預測

禮來將全年營收預測由850億至870億美元，上調至910億至920億美元，區間中值提高55億美元；但調整後每股純益預測由35.50至36.50美元，下修至35至36美元。
公司解釋，若排除交易相關費用，全年獲利展望中值實際提高每股4.07美元，但第三季認列每股4.57美元的收購研發費用，抵銷上述增幅，主要涉及AtaiBeckley與Curevo收購案。
這意味獲利預測下調主要反映交易費用，而非核心業務轉弱。禮來正運用減重藥帶來的資金，透過研發、收購及合作拓展其他治療領域，降低長期成長對GLP-1藥物的依賴。
不過，第三季營收也包含約9億美元的有利因素，主要來自糖尿病藥物Jardiance相關里程碑款項，以及回扣與折扣估計調整。其中4.1億美元為Jardiance里程碑款項，公司預期未來不再收到此類款項。

兩大針劑銷售超標 放量抵銷降價壓力

猛健樂第三季全球銷售年增65%至107.2億美元，優於市場預期，其中美國以外市場銷售大增93%；Zepbound銷售年增49%至53.5億美元，也高於預估的50.9億美元，收入絕大多數來自美國。
兩大產品持續熱銷，顯示需求擴張仍足以抵銷價格下滑。禮來第三季整體銷量增加53%，實際售價則下跌15%。美國營收成長34%至151億美元，銷量增加41%、價格下跌7%；海外營收成長47%至93億美元，銷量增加76%、價格下跌29%，海外降價主要反映猛健樂納入中國國家醫保藥品目錄。
保險給付擴大也是推力。美國7月啟動Medicare臨時試辦計畫，讓符合資格的受益人可獲Zepbound與Foundayo給付。伯恩斯坦分析師指出，近期約70萬名開始使用GLP-1藥物的Medicare患者中，禮來取得約70%市占。
市場原先擔憂，Medicare患者每月自付50美元的新安排，可能伴隨藥廠降價並侵蝕收益。此次強勁銷量有助緩解疑慮，但給付擴張對長期利潤率的影響仍待觀察。

口服減重藥起步落後 下一代療法受矚目

相較針劑，4月在美國上市的每日口服減重藥Foundayo表現較弱，第三季銷售1.84億美元，低於分析師預估2.1686億美元，美國初期處方量也落後諾和諾德(NVO-US)年初推出的口服Wegovy。
投資人正觀察禮來能否縮小競爭對手的先行優勢。Foundayo今年已在美國與英國上市，年底前可能進入其他歐洲市場，海外擴張可望成為後續成長動能。
另一焦點是研發中的下一代減重藥retatrutide，中期試驗顯示平均減重幅度達24%，禮來預計2027年初提出核准申請。該藥尚未獲准上市，安全性與療效仍在研究中；能否順利推進，將是禮來延續減重市場領先地位的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: Eli Lilly (LLY-US) on Thursday (the 29th) released its third-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings (ended September 30) in pre‑market trading, buoyed by strong demand for its diabetes drug Mounjaro and weight‑loss injection Zepbound. Both revenue and adjusted earnings per share beat expectations, and the company sharply raised its full‑year revenue outlook. Despite merger‑related costs dragging down the full‑year profit forecast and sales of the new oral weight‑loss drug Foundayo falling short of expectations, Eli Lilly’s pre‑market share price briefly rose nearly 5%.

According to the report, Lilly’s third‑quarter revenue reached $24.4 billion, above LSEG’s estimate of $22.61 billion; adjusted EPS was $7.48, also topping the forecast of $6.26. Net income rose from $5.58 billion a year earlier to $6.45 billion, and earnings per share increased from $6.21 to $7.22.
At the time of writing, Lilly’s (LLY) pre‑market share price was up 4.25%, reporting $1,343.00 per share.

Full‑Year Revenue Outlook Raised; Merger Costs Lower Profit Forecast
Lilly lifted its full‑year revenue guidance from $85‑$87 billion to $91‑$92 billion, raising the midpoint by $5.5 billion; however, adjusted EPS guidance was trimmed from $35.50‑$36.50 to $35‑$36.

The company explained that excluding transaction‑related expenses, the midpoint of the full‑year profit outlook actually rises by $4.07 per share, but a $4.57 per‑share acquisition‑related R&D charge recognized in Q3 offsets that gain, mainly tied to the Atai‑Beckley and Curevo acquisitions.

This means the profit‑forecast cut mainly reflects transaction costs rather than a weakening core business. Lilly is using cash from its weight‑loss drugs to fund R&D, acquisitions and collaborations that expand into other therapeutic areas, reducing long‑term reliance on GLP‑1 drugs for growth.

However, the third‑quarter revenue also included about $0.9 billion of favorable items, primarily milestone payments related to the diabetes drug Jardiance and adjustments for rebates and discounts. Of that, $0.41 billion was a Jardiance milestone payment that the company expects will not recur in the future.

Both major injectables exceeded sales expectations, offsetting pricing pressure. Mounjaro’s global sales grew 65% year‑over‑year to $10.72 billion, beating market forecasts, with sales outside the U.S. jumping 93%. Zepbound sales rose 49% to $5.35 billion, also above the $5.09 billion estimate, with the bulk of revenue coming from the United States.

The continued strong sales of the two products show that demand expansion still outweighs price declines. Lilly’s overall Q3 volume grew 53% while the average selling price fell 15%. U.S. revenue grew 34% to $15.1 billion, with volume up 41% and price down 7%; overseas revenue rose 47% to $9.3 billion, with volume up 76% and price down 29%, the overseas price cuts mainly reflecting Mounjaro’s inclusion in China’s national health‑insurance drug list.

Expanded insurance coverage also helped. In July, Medicare launched a temporary pilot allowing eligible beneficiaries to receive coverage for Zepbound and Foundayo. Bernstein analysts noted that among roughly 700,000 Medicare patients who recently started GLP‑1 therapy, Lilly captured about 70% market share.

The market had previously worried that the new $50‑per‑month Medicare copay could trigger drug‑maker price cuts and erode revenue. The strong sales this quarter help allay those concerns, but the long‑term impact of expanded coverage on profit margins remains to be seen.

Compared with injectables, the daily oral weight‑loss drug Foundayo, launched in the U.S. in April, performed weaker, posting Q3 sales of $184 million, below analysts’ estimate of $216.86 million, and its early U.S. prescription volume lagged behind Novo Nordisk’s (NVO-US) oral Wegovy launched earlier this year.

Investors are watching whether Lilly can narrow the first‑mover advantage of its rivals. Foundayo is now available in the U.S. and the U.K., and may enter other European markets before year‑end, with overseas expansion expected to become a future growth driver.

Another focus is the next‑generation weight‑loss drug retatrutide, currently in development. Mid‑stage trial data showed an average weight loss of 24%, and Lilly plans to file for approval in early 2027. The drug is not yet approved, and its safety and efficacy are still under study; its progress will be a key indicator of Lilly’s ability to maintain its leadership in the weight‑loss market.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI砸錢何時回本？Alphabet財報失色、通膨又施壓 主要指數開低
paras: 美股周四(29日)開盤走低，Alphabet與開拓重工財報未能滿足市場期待，再度引發投資人對人工智慧(AI)龐大支出與投資回報的疑慮，科技股承壓，標普500指數面臨終結連三日漲勢的壓力。
聯準會(Fed)前一日維持利率不變後，最新公布的美國9月PCE通膨年增率升至3.6%，市場同步評估物價壓力對年底利率走向的影響。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌逾200點或近0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近480點或近1.8%，標普 500 指數跌近0.6%，費城半導體指數跌近2.3%，台積電ADR跌近1.4%。
全球科技股漲勢受挫，Alphabet與三星電子財報表現不如預期，再度引發市場對人工智慧(AI)龐大投資能否帶來足夠回報的疑慮。周四美股盤前，那斯達克100指數期貨下跌1.3%，預示指數可能終結連三日漲勢；標普500指數期貨下跌0.5%，美國第三季經濟成長優於預期，也未能扭轉跌勢。
美債則在聯準會(Fed)周三維持利率不變後持穩，2年期美債殖利率徘徊於4.7%，10年期約5%。市場接下來關注歐洲央行與日本央行決策，兩者均料按兵不動。

AI支出回報受檢驗 科技與設備股承壓

Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston表示，市場並非質疑Alphabet的AI機會，而是在建設成本持續壓抑現金流之際，重新衡量應給予多少價值；投資人對支出、利潤率與現金創造能力不如預期的容忍度正降低。

歐股走揚油價回落 通膨數據牽動美債

歐洲Stoxx600指數上漲0.6%，能源與電信股漲勢抵銷銀行股下跌。殼牌(SHEL-US)宣布大幅增加庫藏股規模後走高，荷蘭國際集團(ING-US)則因獲利不如預期、成本與呆帳準備增加而下跌，並宣布裁減約400人。
油價隨中東外交斡旋進展回落，市場評估相關努力能否避免美國恢復對伊朗軍事打擊，布蘭特原油下跌1%至每桶114.10美元。
Fed周三以10比2維持利率不變後，投資人也關注美國核心個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數。《彭博》策略師Ven Ram指出，2年期美債殖利率過去一個月已下降約25個基點，若通膨高於預期，顯示Fed抑制物價仍有漫長道路，可能引發短天期美債獲利了結賣壓。

items.title: 歐洲央行利率按兵不動 聚焦能源通膨與拉加德繼任人選
items.title_en: ECB Holds Rates Steady, Focus Shifts to Energy Inflation and Lagarde Successor
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)宣布維持關鍵基準利率不變，存款利率維持在2.50%、主要再融資利率為2.65%、邊際貸款利率則為2.90%，決策完全符合市場預期。
與此同時，美國聯準會(Fed)本周維持利率按兵不動，日本央行則預期於周五跟進維持利率政策。
然而，總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)突襲宣布將於明年2月提前卸任，較原定任期提早數月，為本次決策會議拋下震撼彈。拉加德表示，提前離任旨在獲得更多自由，以便對包括法國政治與財政動盪在內的各項議題發聲。
此一重大人事異動不僅遮蔽了利率決策焦點，更提前引發西班牙與荷蘭前央行總裁角逐繼任寶座的競爭。
在宏觀經濟層面，受伊朗戰爭衝擊影響，全球能源價格再度攀升，自上次會議以來原油價格已上漲逾6%，天然氣價格更創下近4年新高。能源價格飆升推升歐元區9月消費者物價指數(CPI)達3.8%，官員憂心通膨恐朝向2%目標的兩倍攀升。
雖然核心通膨與薪資反應目前維持平穩，但高能源成本與金融條件緊縮正持續壓抑需求，預估第三季經濟成長放緩至0.2%，銀行端因風險疑慮而持續收緊放款標準。
歐洲央行強調，未來貨幣政策將持續採取「依賴數據、逐次會議評估」的機制。市場普遍預期央行將於12月再度升息，部分分析師認為這將是本輪循環的最後一次升息，然而受能源成本隱憂影響，也有投資人押注2027年仍有進一步升息的空間。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) announced that it will keep its key policy rates unchanged, with the deposit rate at 2.50%, the main refinancing rate at 2.65%, and the marginal lending rate at 2.90%, a decision fully in line with market expectations.
At the same time, the U.S. Federal Reserve is also holding rates steady this week, while the Bank of Japan is expected to follow suit on Friday and maintain its rate policy.

However, President Christine Lagarde unexpectedly announced that she will step down in February next year, several months earlier than her scheduled term, delivering a shock to the policy meeting. Lagarde said the early departure is meant to give her more freedom to speak on a range of issues, including France’s political and fiscal turmoil.
This major personnel change not only obscured the focus on rate decisions but also accelerated the competition between former central bank heads of Spain and the Netherlands to succeed her.

On the macro side, the global energy market has been hit by the Iran war, pushing oil prices up more than 6% since the last meeting and natural gas to a near‑four‑year high. The surge in energy prices lifted the euro‑area September consumer price index (CPI) to 3.8%, prompting officials to worry that inflation could rise to twice the 2% target.

Although core inflation and wage dynamics remain stable, high energy costs and tighter financial conditions continue to suppress demand, with Q3 growth now projected to slow to 0.2% and banks tightening lending standards over risk concerns.

The ECB stressed that future monetary policy will continue to follow a “data‑dependent, meeting‑by‑meeting” approach. Markets broadly expect another rate hike in December, with some analysts seeing it as the final increase of this cycle, while concerns over energy costs have led some investors to bet on further hikes as late as 2027.

items.title: 〈財報〉業績超標股價卻崩了！開拓重工盤前跌逾10% 市場在怕什麼？
items.title_en: Earnings Beat Yet Stock Crashes: Caterpillar Falls Over 10% Pre‑Market, What’s the Market Worried About?
paras: 有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的開拓重工(CAT-US)周四(29日)美股盤前公布2026會計年度第三季(截至9月30日)財報，營收與調整後每股純益均優於市場預期，未交付訂單也創新高，但公司維持全年營收成長展望，未能化解投資人對人工智慧(AI)基礎建設熱潮能否延續的疑慮，股價盤前一度重挫逾10%。
根據財報，開拓重工第三季營收年增17%至206.8億美元，高於LSEG調查預估的205.5億美元；調整後每股純益由去年同期4.95美元升至7.20美元，優於預估的7.08美元。營業利益率達20.6%，較去年同期提高約3個百分點，也高於市場預期。
截稿前，開拓重工(CAT-US)周四盤前股價下跌9.59%，每股暫報645.00美元。

訂單創高仍難過關 全年展望未上修成焦點

開拓重工第三季未交付訂單總額達781億美元，較第二季增加60億美元，年增382億美元，雖創歷史新高，但增加速度較今年稍早放緩。
公司維持2026年營收成長百分之十幾中段至高段的預測，分析師則預期約18%，接近公司預測區間高端。開拓重工另預估，第四季營收較去年同期僅「溫和」成長，讓期待更強勁展望的投資人失望。
獲利超標的組成也受到檢視。第三季營業利益包含1.28億美元與《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA)關稅退還相關的利益，公司全年關稅成本預估則維持約22億美元。
Oppenheimer分析師Kristen Owen指出，儘管各事業普遍成長，這次獲利超標的品質仍讓投資人看見開拓重工的弱點，顯示市場不只看當季數字，也在檢驗後續成長力道。

能源業務成最大支柱 AI建設面臨政策與融資壓力

開拓重工以黃色挖土機、推土機與大型礦用卡車聞名，如今製造發電機、大型引擎與燃氣渦輪的動力與能源事業，已成為營收最大的業務。第三季該部門營收年增18%至89億美元，採礦與營建業務也分別成長15%及18%。
受惠資料中心用電需求，公司正推動多年擴產計畫，提高大型引擎與燃氣渦輪產能，今年稍早也調高發電設備銷售目標。不過，市場對AI投資回報的疑慮，加上利率攀升推高融資成本，已使相關供應鏈承壓。
資料中心的政治阻力也在增加。美國期中選舉前，耗電、用水及電費上漲疑慮成為競選議題，紐約州等地限制新開發案，增添建設地點與啟用時程的不確定性。
Raymond James分析師Tim Thein則指出，儘管監管與信用風險升溫，經銷商回饋仍顯示訂單需求強勁，尤其大型燃氣引擎交期仍處歷史偏長水準。
截至周三收盤，開拓重工股價已較6月高點下跌約33%。這次財報後再遭拋售，反映即使營運持續成長，市場仍期待更明確的證據，證明AI基建需求足以支撐未來業績。
paras_en: Caterpillar (CAT-US), dubbed the “canary of the economy,” released its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter results (ended September 30) in pre‑market trading on Thursday the 29th. Revenue and adjusted EPS both topped expectations and undelivered orders hit a record high, but the company kept its full‑year revenue outlook unchanged, failing to allay investors’ doubts about whether the AI infrastructure boom can be sustained, and the stock plunged more than 10% in pre‑market trading.

According to the filing, third‑quarter revenue rose 17% year‑over‑year to $20.68 billion, beating LSEG’s forecast of $20.55 billion. Adjusted earnings per share climbed from $4.95 a year ago to $7.20, ahead of the $7.08 estimate. Operating margin hit 20.6%, about three percentage points higher than a year ago and above market expectations.
Just before the article was filed, Caterpillar’s pre‑market share price was down 9.59%, reporting a temporary price of $645.00 per share.

Despite record‑high undelivered orders, the company still struggled to clear the hurdle, and its unchanged full‑year outlook became the focus. Caterpillar’s undelivered order backlog for the quarter reached $78.1 billion, up $6 billion from the prior quarter and $38.2 billion year‑over‑year, a historic high though the growth rate has slowed slightly from earlier in the year.

The firm kept its 2026 revenue growth forecast in the mid‑to‑high teens percent range, while analysts expect roughly 18%, near the top of the company’s own range. Caterpillar also warned that fourth‑quarter revenue would only grow “moderately” versus the same period last year, disappointing investors hoping for a stronger outlook.

The composition of the earnings beat also drew scrutiny. The quarter’s operating profit included a $128 million benefit related to refunds under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), and the company continues to estimate full‑year tariff costs at about $2.2 billion.

Oppenheimer analyst Kristen Owen noted that although most business segments grew, the quality of this earnings beat revealed Caterpillar’s weaknesses, showing that the market is looking beyond the headline numbers to assess future growth momentum.

Energy remains Caterpillar’s biggest pillar, while AI construction faces policy and financing pressure. Known for its yellow excavators, bulldozers and large mining trucks, the company’s power and energy segment—making generators, large engines and gas turbines—has become its largest revenue source. That segment’s revenue grew 18% year‑over‑year to $8.9 billion in the quarter, with mining and construction businesses up 15% and 18% respectively.

Benefiting from data‑center power demand, the company is pushing a multi‑year capacity‑expansion plan to boost large‑engine and gas‑turbine output and earlier this year raised its sales target for power‑generation equipment. However, market concerns over AI investment returns, coupled with rising interest rates that increase financing costs, are putting pressure on the related supply chain.

Political resistance to data‑center expansion is also rising. Ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, concerns about electricity, water usage and higher utility bills have become campaign issues, and states such as New York are restricting new developments, adding uncertainty to construction sites and project timelines.

Raymond James analyst Tim Thein pointed out that despite heightened regulatory and credit risks, dealer feedback still shows strong order demand, especially as delivery times for large gas engines remain historically long.

By Wednesday’s close, Caterpillar’s share price had fallen about 33% from its June high. The post‑earnings sell‑off underscores that even with continued operational growth, the market still wants clearer evidence that AI infrastructure demand is robust enough to support future performance.

items.title: 企業投資與消費強勁 美國第三季GDP年化成長率達3.4% 優於預期
items.title_en: Strong Corporate Investment and Consumer Spending Drive US Q3 GDP Annualized Growth to 3.4%, Beating Expectations
paras: 根據美國經濟分析局(BEA)與商務部周四(29日)發布的初估數據，美國第三季GDP經季節調整後以年率計算達 3.4%，顯著高於第二季的 2.2%，並優於彭博調查與道瓊共識預期的 3.2%，創下一年來最快經濟擴張速度。
在推動成長的動力方面，商務部報告指出，熱絡的企業投資與展現韌性的家庭支出為兩大核心主軸。受到人工智慧(AI)相關投資熱潮帶動，設備支出對 GDP 的貢獻創下 2011 年以來新高(排除疫情後復甦期)。同時，家庭消費支出年化成長率達 3.8%，高於預期的 3.4%，連續兩季保持強勁動能。
儘管經濟擴張亮眼，商務部數據顯示通膨壓力依然升溫。9 月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數月增 0.5%，創下6個月來最大增幅，年增率則為 3.6%。扣除食品與能源的核心 PCE 物價指數月增 0.3%、年增 3.1%，均符合道瓊共識預期。
報告發布的前一天，聯準會剛剛投票決定將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%的區間內。儘管通膨數據處於高位，但聯準會官員堅稱，他們有時間在做出下一步決策前，先對後續出爐的數據進行評估。
聯準會主席凱文華許(Kevin Warsh)表示：「我們即將面臨的這段時期，資訊量非常豐富。全球正在發生許多事情，我和我的同事們都非常關注這些動態。」
這份報告是下周期中選舉前最後一份關鍵經濟體檢表。整體數據展現出美國經濟的韌性與復甦動能，優於預期的表現，將進一步提振市場與政策制定者對經濟前景的信心。
paras_en: According to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and the Commerce Department’s preliminary estimates released on Thursday (the 29th), seasonally adjusted U.S. third‑quarter GDP grew at an annualized rate of 3.4%, markedly higher than the 2.2% recorded in the second quarter and above the Bloomberg survey and Dow Jones consensus forecast of 3.2%, marking the fastest expansion in a year.

In terms of growth drivers, the Commerce Department report highlighted vigorous corporate investment and resilient household spending as the two core pillars. Fueled by a wave of AI‑related investment, equipment spending’s contribution to GDP hit a post‑pandemic high not seen since 2011. At the same time, household consumption grew at an annualized 3.8%, outpacing the 3.4% forecast and maintaining strong momentum for a second consecutive quarter.

Despite the impressive expansion, the Commerce Department data showed inflationary pressure remains elevated. The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, the largest increase in six months, with an annual rise of 3.6%. The core PCE price index, which excludes food and energy, increased 0.3% month‑over‑month and 3.1% year‑over‑year, both in line with Dow Jones consensus expectations.

The day before the report’s release, the Federal Reserve had just voted to keep the target federal funds rate in the 3.75%‑4% range. Although inflation data remain high, Fed officials said they have time to assess upcoming data before making the next policy move.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said, “We are entering a period that is information‑rich. A lot is happening globally, and my colleagues and I are closely monitoring these dynamics.”

This report is the last key economic health check before the mid‑term elections next week. The overall data demonstrate the resilience and recovery momentum of the U.S. economy, outperforming expectations and likely to further boost market and policymaker confidence in the economic outlook.

items.title: 通膨又來施壓！美國9月PCE年增3.6% Fed12月升息機率逾八成
items.title_en: Inflation Returns to Pressure! US September PCE Up 3.6% YoY, Fed's December Rate Hike Odds Over 80%
paras: 美國9月通膨加速，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率升至3.6%，扣除食品與能源的核心PCE年增率也攀至3.1%，強化市場對聯準會(Fed)12月升息的預期。儘管名目消費支出持續增加，扣除物價因素後卻停滯，顯示家庭支出成長受到漲價推動，實際消費動能轉弱。
美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)周四(29日)公布，9月PCE物價指數月增0.5%，高於8月的0.3%，符合經濟學家預期；年增率則由8月的3.4%升至3.6%，為5月以來最高。汽油與其他商品價格上漲，是推升通膨的重要因素。
扣除波動較大的食品與能源後，9月核心PCE月增0.3%，符合預期；8月增幅則由原估0.2%上修至0.3%。核心PCE年增率由8月的3.0%升至3.1%，同樣符合市場預估，但仍明顯高於Fed的2%通膨目標。
價格壓力也不僅限於能源。排除住房的服務價格指標，也就是市場關注的「超級核心」PCE，年增率升至2024年12月以來最高，顯示服務業通膨仍具黏著性，增加Fed防止漲價壓力擴散的挑戰。
Fed周三維持基準利率於3.75%至4.00%，並在聲明中承認通膨「仍然偏高」。主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在記者會表示，能源及相關價格最近幾周再度上漲，Fed的任務是確保部分產業的相對價格變動，不會擴散至整體經濟，同時維持通膨預期穩定。
根據芝商所FedWatch工具，金融市場預估Fed在12月升息的機率約為83.3%。最新PCE數據雖未超出預期，但整體與核心通膨同步走高，支持經濟學家對年底再度升息的判斷。
消費方面，占美國經濟活動逾三分之二的個人消費支出，9月月增0.5%，低於市場預估的0.6%，也較8月的0.9%放緩。扣除通膨後，實質消費支出與前月持平，意味消費以較弱的成長動能邁入第四季。
同月個人所得僅增加0.2%，低於預期的0.5%，增幅也落後消費支出，個人儲蓄率因而降至2022年10月以來最低。物價上漲、所得增幅有限與儲蓄緩衝縮小，凸顯美國家庭面臨的壓力。
同日公布的第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初估顯示，美國經濟經季節調整後換算成年率成長3.4%，消費支出以相同口徑成長3.8%。不過，9月實質消費停滯，也提醒市場，第三季整體成長強勁，未必代表季末需求同樣穩健。
paras_en: US September inflation accelerated, with the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rising 3.6% year‑over‑year and the core PCE (excluding food and energy) climbing to 3.1%, bolstering market expectations of a Fed rate hike in December. Although nominal consumer spending kept rising, real spending stalled after stripping out price effects, indicating that household spending growth was driven by higher prices and that underlying consumption momentum is weakening.

The US Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) released on Thursday the September PCE data, showing a 0.5% monthly increase, up from 0.3% in August and in line with economists’ forecasts; the annual rate rose from 3.4% in August to 3.6%, the highest since May. Higher gasoline and other commodity prices were key drivers of the inflation rise.

Excluding the more volatile food and energy components, September core PCE rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, matching expectations; August’s increase was revised up from an initial 0.2% to 0.3%. The core PCE annual rate rose from 3.0% in August to 3.1%, also in line with market estimates but still well above the Fed’s 2% inflation target.

Price pressures are not limited to energy. The services‑excluding‑housing price index, often called the “super‑core” PCE that markets watch, posted its highest annual growth since December 2024, showing that service‑sector inflation remains sticky and adding to the Fed’s challenge of preventing price pressures from spreading.

The Fed kept its target rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00% on Wednesday and acknowledged in its statement that inflation is “still too high.” Chair Kevin Warsh told reporters that energy and related prices have risen again in recent weeks, and the Fed’s job is to ensure that price movements in certain sectors do not spill over to the broader economy while keeping inflation expectations anchored.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, financial markets estimate an about 83.3% probability that the Fed will raise rates in December. Although the latest PCE numbers did not exceed expectations, the simultaneous rise in headline and core inflation supports economists’ view that another rate hike is likely at year‑end.

On the consumption side, personal consumption expenditures – which account for more than two‑thirds of US economic activity – grew 0.5% in September, below the market forecast of 0.6% and slower than August’s 0.9% gain. After stripping out inflation, real consumption was flat versus the prior month, meaning spending entered the fourth quarter with weaker growth momentum.

Personal income in the same month rose only 0.2%, well under the 0.5% expected, lagging behind consumption growth and pushing the personal savings rate down to its lowest level since October 2022. Rising prices, modest income gains and a shrinking savings buffer highlight the pressure on US households.

The third‑quarter GDP advance, released the same day, showed a seasonally adjusted annualized growth rate of 3.4% for the economy, with consumption growing at the same 3.8% pace. However, the stagnation of real consumption in September reminds markets that strong overall Q3 growth does not necessarily imply equally robust demand at the end of the quarter.

items.title: 從網路泡沫到金融危機 這項「幾乎沒錯過」的指標再讓市場戒備？
items.title_en: From the Dot‑Com Bubble to the Financial Crisis: This ‘Almost‑Missed’ Indicator Raises Market Vigilance Again?
paras: 美股市場在經歷創紀錄的升勢後近期出現震盪回檔，標普 500 指數、道瓊指數與那斯達克指數分別自今年高點下挫約 2%、3% 及 5%。同時，反映市場情緒的「恐慌與貪婪指數」落入 32，處於「恐慌」區間，顯示投資人焦慮情緒升溫。
《The Motley Fool》財經分析師Katie Brockman撰文指出，雖然股市修正終將發生，但透過歷史上精準度極高的經濟衰退指標——殖利率曲線倒掛，可為投資人提供客觀的市場觀測依據，儘管現在還未發生，但仍應密切觀察。

最著名及可靠的衰退指標

Brockman表示，當長期利率低於短期利率時，殖利率曲線就會倒掛，自1970年代以來，幾乎每一次經濟衰退之前都出現了殖利率曲線倒掛的現象。其中，市場最密切追蹤的是「10 年期與 2 年期美債殖利率利差」。
以下是三次倒掛後的股市表現：

網路泡沫：2000 年 2 月此利差發生倒掛，僅一個月後股市便正式步入熊市。
全球金融危機：2006 年殖利率曲線再度倒掛，隨後美國於 2007 年底爆發大衰退。
2022 年市場震盪：2022 年殖利率曲線再次倒掛，儘管技術上未界定為經濟衰退，但在高通膨與美國聯準會連續升息衝擊下，股市仍跌入熊市。


然而，Brockman強調，殖利率曲線雖然準確，也無法精確預測衰退何時開始、持續多久或嚴峻程度為何。
針對當前情勢，Brockman表示，殖利率曲線自 2024 年以來已結束倒掛，目前呈現向下傾斜的型態。然而，考量到聯準會未來仍保有升息選項，殖利率曲線未來的走向仍具高度不確定性。

投資應對建議

面對難以避免的市場景氣循環，Brockman認為與其焦慮於預測衰退時機，不如專注於優化投資組合。她建議投資人應選股聚焦基本面，佈局具備持久競爭優勢與健康財務狀況的優質企業，這是股票能否在經歷衰退後迅速反彈的關鍵分水嶺。
此外，應著眼長期總報酬。歷史數據顯示，自 2000 年 1 月至今，標普 500 指數儘管歷經多次重大熊市，累計漲幅仍超過 750%。
Brockman總結，堅持持有高基本面品質的股票，將能幫助投資人的投資組合順利渡過極端波動，並在長期取得正向回報。
paras_en: U.S. equity markets, after a record‑setting rally, have recently entered a volatile pullback, with the S&P 500, Dow Jones and Nasdaq down about 2%, 3% and 5% from their year‑highs. At the same time, the “Fear & Greed Index” fell to 32, placing it in the “fear” zone and indicating rising investor anxiety.

The Motley Fool analyst Katie Brockman wrote that while a market correction is inevitable, the historically precise recession gauge—the yield‑curve inversion—can give investors an objective market outlook. Although a reversal hasn’t occurred yet, it warrants close monitoring.

The most famous and reliable recession signal, Brockman notes, is when long‑term rates fall below short‑term rates, causing the yield curve to invert. Since the 1970s, an inversion has preceded almost every recession, with market participants watching the spread between the 10‑year and 2‑year U.S. Treasury yields most closely.
The article lists stock‑market performance after three past inversions:

During the dot‑com bubble, the 10‑year/2‑year spread inverted in February 2000, and a month later the market officially entered a bear phase. The global financial crisis saw another inversion in 2006, followed by the U.S. Great Recession at the end of 2007. In 2022 the curve inverted again; while not technically a recession, high inflation and successive Fed rate hikes still pushed equities into bear‑market territory.
Brockman cautions that, although the yield curve is accurate, it cannot pinpoint exactly when a recession will start, how long it will last, or how severe it will be.

Regarding the current environment, Brockman says the yield curve ended its inversion in 2024 and now slopes downward. Yet, because the Fed still retains the option to raise rates, the future shape of the curve remains highly uncertain.

Investment advice: Facing inevitable economic cycles, Brockman argues that instead of obsessing over timing a recession, investors should focus on optimizing portfolios. She recommends selecting stocks with strong fundamentals—companies with durable competitive advantages and solid balance sheets—as the key differentiator for rapid post‑recession rebounds.
She adds that a long‑term total‑return perspective is essential. Historical data show that from January 2000 to today, the S&P 500 has risen over 750% despite multiple major bear markets.

items.title: 拉加德提前走人！ECB接班兩強浮現 誰來接招通膨與法債風險？
items.title_en: Lagarde Leaves Early! Two Strong Candidates Emerge to Lead the ECB Amid Inflation and French Debt Risks
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)周四(29日)宣布，將於2027年2月7日提前卸任，比原訂同年10月底任期屆滿提早近九個月。此舉讓接班競逐進入關鍵階段，前西班牙央行總裁戴柯斯(Pablo Hernández de Cos)與前荷蘭央行總裁諾特(Klaas Knot)被視為最有力人選。
綜合《CNBC》與《彭博》報導，歐洲理事會主席柯斯塔(António Costa)表示，繼任者遴選程序將立即展開。歐元區21個成員國可能力爭年底前達成共識，並一併協商明年即將出缺的ECB首席經濟學家與執行理事職位。
拉加德在ECB公布最新利率決策前宣布辭職，感謝團隊過去七年的支持，並獲管理委員會起立鼓掌。她任內歷經疫情、俄烏戰爭與能源價格衝擊；如今歐元區9月通膨再攀三年高點，接班人仍須面對物價與金融穩定的雙重考驗。

戴柯斯民調領先 諾特具金融穩定經驗

現年55歲、目前掌舵國際清算銀行(BIS)的戴柯斯，在《彭博》分析師調查中居於領先。他已獲西班牙總理桑傑士支持，可能在11月29日提前大選勝出的中間偏右人民黨，也表態支持他，降低政黨輪替對提名的影響。
戴柯斯過去被視為偏鴿派，但若提前離開BIS，可能引發對該機構聲譽及接班安排的疑慮，成為競逐ECB職位的阻力。
59歲的諾特則於8月獲荷蘭政府正式提名。他曾任金融穩定委員會(FSB)主席，相關經驗被認為有助應對債市動盪。不過，他自2025年中卸任荷蘭央行總裁後已離開決策第一線一段時間，加上荷蘭過去已出過ECB總裁，可能影響各國支持意願。
諾特原被視為鷹派，曾反對前總裁德拉吉的部分寬鬆政策，之後立場逐漸溫和。他本月仍表示，經濟與地緣政治衝擊可能要求ECB未來幾年略偏向緊縮。

法國債務風險升溫 接班角力牽動政策方向

接班安排不僅涉及專業能力，也牽涉國籍、區域與性別平衡。德國央行總裁內格爾(Joachim Nagel)、義大利央行總裁帕內塔(Fabio Panetta)，以及歐洲投資銀行總裁卡爾維尼奧(Nadia Calviño)，也曾被點名；卡爾維尼奧已否認參選意願，但仍有人認為，各國可能尋求另一名女性接任。
新總裁除須讓通膨回到2%，也得處理法國債務壓力與歐元區公債利差擴大的風險。法國明年總統大選更添變數，市場正討論ECB是否可能動用干預工具。
《彭博》經濟研究認為，相較戴柯斯，諾特可能採取較緊的貨幣政策，對干預法國債市也較不積極。Berenberg首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding則指出，諾特的金融穩定經驗可能成為優勢，但ECB無意替法國失衡的財政政策埋單。
至於拉加德下一步，英國《金融時報》(FT)曾報導，她是世界經濟論壇下一任主席的熱門人選；她近期則暗示，無意角逐2027年法國總統。
paras_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde announced on Thursday the 29th that she will step down early on February 7, 2027, nearly nine months before her term was set to end in late October 2027. Her early departure pushes the succession race into a critical phase, with former Spanish central bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos and former Dutch central bank governor Klaas Knot seen as the strongest contenders.

According to reports from CNBC and Bloomberg, European Council President António Costa said the selection process for her successor will start immediately. The 21 euro‑area member states are expected to strive for a consensus by the end of the year and will also negotiate the appointments for the ECB’s chief economist and an executive board seat that will become vacant next year.

Lagarde resigned just before the ECB announced its latest rate decision, thanking her team for seven years of support and receiving a standing ovation from the management board. Her tenure spanned the pandemic, the Russia‑Ukraine war and energy price shocks; now euro‑area inflation in September has climbed to a three‑year high, and her successor will still have to face the dual challenge of price stability and financial stability.

At 55, de Cos, who now heads the Bank for International Settlements, leads a Bloomberg analyst poll. He has the backing of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and the centre‑right People’s Party, which is expected to win an early election on November 29, further reducing the impact of a change of government on his nomination.

De Cos has previously been viewed as dovish, but an early departure from the BIS could raise concerns about the institution’s reputation and succession plan, potentially becoming a hurdle in the race for the ECB chairmanship.

The 59‑year‑old Knot was formally nominated by the Dutch government in August. He previously chaired the Financial Stability Board, experience seen as useful for dealing with bond‑market turbulence. However, he left the front line of decision‑making after stepping down as Dutch central bank governor in mid‑2025, and the fact that the Netherlands has already produced an ECB president may affect the level of support from other countries.

Knot was originally seen as a hawk, having opposed some of former President Draghi’s easing measures, but his stance has gradually softened. He said this month that economic and geopolitical shocks could require the ECB to tilt slightly more towards tightening over the next few years.

The succession not only involves professional competence but also considerations of nationality, regional balance and gender. Germany’s central bank president Joachim Nagel, Italy’s central bank governor Fabio Panetta and European Investment Bank president Nadia Calviño have also been mentioned; Calviño has denied any interest in running, yet some argue that countries may still look for another woman to take the role.

The new president will have to bring inflation back to 2% while also dealing with French debt pressures and the risk of widening sovereign‑bond spreads across the euro area. France’s presidential election next year adds further uncertainty, and markets are debating whether the ECB might resort to intervention tools.

Bloomberg’s economic research suggests that, compared with de Cos, Knot may pursue a tighter monetary stance and be less inclined to intervene in the French bond market. Berenberg chief economist Holger Schmieding notes that Knot’s financial‑stability background could be an advantage, but the ECB has no intention of footing the bill for France’s imbalanced fiscal policy.

As for Lagarde’s next move, the Financial Times reported that she is a leading candidate to become the next chair of the World Economic Forum; she has recently hinted that she has no intention of running for the French presidency in 2027.

items.title: 印尼央行積極護盤 印尼盾連跌6日後迎來反彈
items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Actively Supports Market as Rupiah Rebounds After Six Days of Decline
paras: 印尼盾(IDR)在經歷連續6個交易日下跌後，周四(29日)強勁反彈，以擺脫在歷史低點附近徘徊。
美元兌印尼盾匯率自 10 月 27 日創下的近5個月高點 18,223 回落，盤中一度走軟至 18,185，隨後回升至 18,108 至 18,127 區間，跌幅達 0.4%，有望創下自 9 月 30 日以來的最大單日跌幅。
FXStreet 分析師 Akhtar Faruqui 指出，印尼盾走強主要受到印尼中央銀行積極護盤的支撐。印尼央行重申，將持續透過無本金交割遠期外匯(NDF)、國內無本金交割遠期外匯(DNDF)、現貨市場干預，以及在次級市場購入國債等多重工具以穩定匯市。
外部環境方面，美國聯準會決議將基準利率維持在 3.75%–4.00% 不變。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)發表談話時重申，公開市場委員會(FOMC)將堅守物價穩定與 2% 的通膨目標，並強調底層經濟成長依然強勁。
不過此項利率決策並未獲得全體一致同意，聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭Fed主席哈馬克(Beth Hammack)投下反對票，主張應立即升息1碼(25 個基點)以應對居高不下的物價壓力。華許更為溫和的表態被市場解讀為偏向鴿派，進一步推升了亞洲主要貨幣。
儘管央行出手干預，印尼當地金融市場仍承受顯著壓力。印尼 10 年期公債殖利率一度攀升至7.7%–7.707% 的近年新高，顯著高於 2026 財年預算設定的 6.9% 基準，隨後微幅下降 3 個基點至 7.62%。
由於市場對財政風險及通膨隱憂未除，加上印尼在 MSCI 指數中面臨可能被降級為獨立市場狀態的不確定性，導致外資持續賣超並引發資本外流疑慮。雅加達綜合指數仍下挫 2% 至 5,175.15 點。
交易員目前正密切關注即將公布的 9 月貿易數據與 10 月通膨報告，以評估後續經濟與匯率走勢。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah (IDR) staged a strong rebound on Thursday (the 29th) after six consecutive trading days of decline, shaking off its slide near historic lows.

The USD/IDR rate fell from the near‑five‑month high of 18,223 set on October 27, slipping intraday to as low as 18,185 before climbing back into the 18,108‑18,127 range, a drop of about 0.4% that could mark the biggest single‑day decline since September 30.

FXStreet analyst Akhtar Faruqui said the rupiah’s strength is mainly backed by the Bank Indonesia’s active market‑support measures. The central bank reiterated it will continue to use a mix of non‑deliverable forwards (NDF), domestic NDFs (DNDF), spot market interventions and purchases of government bonds in the secondary market to stabilise the exchange rate.

On the external front, the U.S. Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00%. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, in his remarks, reaffirmed that the Federal Open Market Committee will stay committed to price stability and a 2% inflation target, stressing that underlying economic growth remains robust.

However, the rate decision was not unanimous; Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted against it, arguing for an immediate 25‑basis‑point hike to curb persistent inflation pressures. Warsh’s more dovish tone was read by markets as a tilt toward easing, further lifting major Asian currencies.

Despite the central bank’s intervention, Indonesia’s domestic financial markets remain under significant strain. The 10‑year government bond yield briefly spiked to a recent high of 7.7%‑7.707%, well above the 6.9% benchmark set in the FY2026 budget, before easing by three basis points to 7.62%.

Because fiscal‑risk and inflation concerns persist, and Indonesia faces the possibility of being reclassified as a frontier market in MSCI indices, foreign investors continue to sell, raising worries about capital outflows. The Jakarta Composite Index fell another 2% to 5,175.15 points.
Traders are now closely watching the upcoming September trade data and October inflation report to gauge the next moves in the economy and the rupiah.

items.title: 歐洲央行料將維持利率不變 以評估法國動盪及能源風險
items.title_en: ECB Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged to Assess French Turmoil and Energy Risks
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(29日)預計將基準存款利率維持在 2.50% 不變，暫緩升息步伐。儘管中東伊朗衝突引發原油價格震盪與通膨隱憂，但在歐元區經濟動態放緩與法國國債市場劇烈波動的雙重夾擊下，決策者普遍選擇維持政策現狀，並將目光投向 12 月的政策展望。
歐元區當前通膨率接近 4%，遠高於 2% 的政策目標，但升幅主要集中於能源領域。彭博經濟研究(Bloomberg Economics)分析師David Powell與Simona Delle Chiaie指出：「歐洲央行幾乎肯定會在本次會議暫停升息；借貸成本上升已收緊金融條件，面對主權債券市場動盪，決策者希望避免火上澆油。」
德國貝倫貝格銀行首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding表示：「歐洲央行可能會表明，近期油價再度飆升，使通膨上行風險比 9 月時更為顯著。」
歐洲央行管理委員會委員Pierre Wunsch指出，市場預估央行未來將採取更多行動「是合理的基準情境，但全球仍處於極具不確定性的環境中」。貨幣市場目前定價年底前仍可能重啟升息，預估存款利率最終可能推升至 3.25%。
除了貨幣政策路線，法國公債市場的動盪成為即時挑戰。受預算赤字膨脹、政治分歧與社會動盪影響，法國 10 年期國債殖利率升破 5%，創下 24 年新高，與德國基準公債的利差亦擴大至 15 年新高。
針對央行是否干預，法國安盛集團(AXA Group)首席經濟學家Gilles Moec認為：「保留歐洲央行干預市場的可能性至關重要。」
但是，Lombard Odier歐洲、中東及非洲地區投資長Nannette Hechler-Fayd'Herbe強調：「干預門檻相當高，除非真的面臨擴散風險、金融市場運作失序或全歐流動性緊縮，否則不預計歐央行會動用傳播保護工具(TPI)。」
Algebris 基金管理公司經濟學家團隊分析，目前法國風險仍侷限於國內，若發生溢出效應，央行可能考慮對其他成員國啟用 TPI，但對法國保持立場。
市場同時高度關注歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)的去留問題，傳聞指出拉加德可能提前接任世界經濟論壇(WEF)主席。日本三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深經濟學家Henry Cook警告：「在央行面臨金融條件收緊、能源價格上漲及總體經濟前景不確定性升級之際，領導層出現任何不確定性都絕非理想狀況。」
目前荷蘭前央行總裁 Klaas Knot 與西班牙前央行總裁 Pablo Hernandez de Cos 被視為接任歐洲央行總裁的熱門人選。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 29th) is expected to keep its key deposit rate at 2.50%, pausing its rate‑hiking cycle. Despite oil price swings and inflation concerns sparked by the Middle‑East conflict involving Iran, policymakers are broadly opting to maintain the status quo amid slowing euro‑area economic activity and sharp volatility in the French sovereign bond market, turning their attention to the policy outlook for December.

Euro‑area inflation is currently close to 4%, well above the 2% target, but the rise is largely confined to energy. Bloomberg Economics analysts David Powell and Simona Delle Chiaie note, “The ECB is almost certain to pause rate hikes at this meeting; higher borrowing costs have already tightened financial conditions, and facing sovereign‑bond market turbulence, policymakers want to avoid adding fuel to the fire.”
Germany’s Berenberg Bank chief economist Holger Schmieding said, “The ECB may point out that the recent surge in oil prices makes inflation‑upside risks more pronounced than they were in September.”

ECB Governing Council member Pierre Wunsch said that market expectations of further ECB action “are a reasonable baseline scenario, but the world remains highly uncertain.” Money markets are still pricing in the possibility of a rate hike before year‑end, with the deposit rate potentially climbing to 3.25% eventually.

Beyond monetary policy, turbulence in the French sovereign‑bond market is an immediate challenge. Driven by a widening budget deficit, political divisions and social unrest, the yield on France’s 10‑year bond has broken above 5%, a 24‑year high, while the spread over German benchmark bonds has widened to a 15‑year peak.
Regarding possible ECB intervention, AXA Group chief economist Gilles Moec said, “Keeping the option of ECB market intervention open is crucial.”

However, Lombard Odier’s head of investment for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Nannette Hechler‑Fayd’Herbe, stressed, “The intervention threshold is quite high; unless there is a genuine spill‑over risk, a breakdown in market functioning, or a Europe‑wide liquidity squeeze, the ECB is not expected to deploy its Transmission Protection Instrument (TPI).”

Algebris fund‑management economists argue that French risk remains largely domestic; if spill‑over effects emerge, the ECB might consider using TPI for other member states, but would maintain its stance on France.

Markets are also closely watching the fate of ECB President Christine Lagarde, with rumours that she could take over the World Economic Forum (WEF) chairmanship ahead of schedule. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group senior economist Henry Cook warned, “When the central bank faces tighter financial conditions, rising energy prices and escalating macro‑economic uncertainty, any uncertainty about its leadership is far from ideal.”
Former Dutch central‑bank governor Klaas Knot and former Spanish central‑bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos are currently seen as the leading candidates to succeed Lagarde as ECB president.

隨著也門戰事持續，外界擔憂中東能源進一步受擾提升油價，美元仍保持避險貨幣地位，而且儘管日本政府一再否認，但其整體立場偏向再通貨膨脹，可能設法推遲BOJ升息，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓升至158.34高點。隨後美國公布9月商品貿易逆差意外擴大至1,349億美元，並據FED以10票贊成、理事庫克和克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈馬克主張加息25個基點，如預期維持聯邦基金利率區間在3.75%-4.00%，而且FED主席沃什在新聞會表示，經濟成長強勁的和通貨膨脹高企，未來仍可能再收緊貨幣政策，芝加哥商品交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具則顯示FED在12月加息的機率85%，但本次會議結果已在廣泛預期中，引發美元兌日圓回落。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.50-70，阻力於158.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)較前季升1.3%及較上年同期漲3.9%，澳洲央行(RBA)總裁布洛克則警告物價壓力仍居高不下，政策制定者將於下周討論今年四次升息是否足以實現通貨膨脹目標，提升RBA下週二加息25個基點的機率至88%，但紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)意外維持利率不變，儘管稱未來或仍需收緊政策，引發紐元暴跌，並據德國報告稱，受中國需求轉弱拖累出口，今年德國對亞太地區二十九個經濟體的出口料下降3.2%至1,853億歐元，對亞太貿易逆差料創紀錄高位，推低歐元兌美元至1.1131低點。
據紐倫堡市場決策研究所(NIM)與市場研究機構GfK調查，德國11月消費者信心指數下滑至負30.8，但歐洲央行(ECB)週四的政策會議預計維持利率不變，市場關注ECB對能源價格推動的第二輪通貨膨脹效應提供任何暗示，而且FED決議後美元走弱，歐元兌美元反彈至1.1169高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1140-60，支撐於1.1060-80。
◆GBP/USD

週三英國財政大臣希利料公布審慎的預算計畫，試圖避免讓首相伯納姆的新政府面臨更大的債券市場壓力，市場關注政府如何增加財政收入以支持經濟增長，但英國財政狀況可能比許多歐洲國家緊張，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3269低點，隨著英國財政大臣約翰希利公布首相伯納姆政府的首份財政預算，承諾堅持政府的財政規則，同時向英國家庭發放小額直接補貼及降低食品雜貨關稅，以緩解能源價格上漲衝擊，市場反應正向，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3338高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3315-35，支撐於1.3230-50。

Higher Japanese government‑bond yields and end‑of‑month fund inflows pushed the dollar‑yen down to a low of 157.63 on Wednesday.

As the war in Yemen drags on, concerns that Middle‑East energy supplies could be further disrupted and push oil prices higher keep the dollar in safe‑haven mode. Fed Chair Waller said in a news conference that strong growth and high inflation could lead to further monetary tightening. The CME FedWatch tool shows an 85 % probability of a December rate hike. The meeting outcome was widely anticipated, prompting the dollar‑yen to retreat. The dollar‑yen is expected to find support around 157.50‑70 and face resistance near 158.30‑50 today.

In contrast, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly left rates unchanged, though it said further tightening may be needed, sending the kiwi tumbling. paras: 美元周三(28日)兌主要貨幣走跌，聯準會(Fed)公布符合市場預期的利率決策。另一方面，紐西蘭央行意外決定維持利率不變，導致紐西蘭幣大幅下跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.15。
聯準會一如預期維持利率不變，選擇等到下週美國期中選舉結束後，再決定是否調整借貸成本，同時等待更多通膨走勢的相關數據。

歐元兌美元上漲0.32%，至1.1160美元。
美元兌日元下跌0.04%，至157.87日元。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，「由於殖利率曲線趨陡，美元比聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前更為疲軟。」

英國財政大臣John Healey週三向國會表示，政府將提高銀行、博弈業者、儲蓄者及房東的稅負，同時收緊亞馬遜等線上市場平台的加值型營業稅規定，以籌措英國預算方案所需資金。

In the late New York session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 102.15.

James St. Aubin, chief investment officer at Ocean Park Asset Management, said, “The outcome of this meeting was fully in line with market expectations; the likelihood of a hike was never high.”

items.title: 油價居高不下的代價！加拿大央行升息1碼 可能還得再升
items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 紐西蘭央行意外按兵不動 維持利率於2.75% 委員會意見分歧
items.title_en: New Zealand Central Bank Unexpectedly Holds Rate at 2.75% Amid Committee Split
paras: 紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)周三(28日)出乎市場意料，決定將官方現金利率(OCR)維持在 2.75% 不變。在媒體調查的 25 位經濟學家當中，僅有 2 位預期利率將維持不動，其餘多數專家均預估央行會升息 1 碼(25 個基點)。
決策公布後，紐元兌美元一度重挫 1.7%(跌至 55.86 美分)，紐西蘭基準股指 NZX 50 下跌 0.5%，對政策敏感的 2 年期政府公債殖利率則下滑 12 個基點至 3.82%。
根據央行公布的會議紀錄，貨幣政策委員會(MPC)最終以 4 比 3 的微幅差距通過按兵不動的決議。委員Paul Conway、Hayley Gourley與Karen Silk投票支持升息 1 碼至 3.00%；然而包含總裁Anna Breman與Prasanna Gai在內的 4 位委員則選擇維持利率不變。
主張暫緩升息者指出，當前經濟復甦步調脆弱，特別是家庭消費與投資意願低迷，且全球地緣政治與經濟環境突變的風險升高，因此宜採取觀望態度。
紐西蘭央行總裁 Breman表示：「在本次會議中，我們認為符合先前溝通方針是適當的，即維持基準利率不變，並持續釋出未來幾次會議極可能進一步升息的訊號。」
針對紐元下挫對通膨的影響，Breman補充說明：「當面對通膨壓力時，我們當然樂見紐元走強，但我們必須將其與影響中長期通膨的所有其他因素綜合權衡。因此我們正在密切觀察並謹慎評估其對未來通膨的影響。」
然而，這項決策遭到市場經濟學家的強烈質疑。Bank of New Zealand研究主管Stephen Toplis表示：「坦白說，我們對紐西蘭央行維持利率不變的決定感到大吃一驚。雖然央行並無義務跟隨市場定價或共識，但如此背道而馳極為罕見。央行此舉推動本已疲軟的紐元進一步下跌，瞬間加劇了通膨壓力。」
儘管紐西蘭 9 月季度消費者物價年增率已自前季的 4.1% 放緩至 3.7%，但仍高於央行設定的 1% 至 3% 目標區間。紐西蘭央行強調，若國內物價壓力未能有效緩解，後續會議仍不排除重新採取緊縮政策。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) on Wednesday (the 28th) surprised markets by deciding to keep the official cash rate (OCR) unchanged at 2.75%. Of the 25 economists surveyed by the media, only two expected the rate to stay steady, while the majority forecast a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike.

After the decision was announced, the New Zealand dollar fell as much as 1.7% against the U.S. dollar, sliding to US$0.5586, the NZX 50 index dropped 0.5%, and the policy‑sensitive two‑year government bond yield slipped 12 basis points to 3.82%.

According to the minutes released by the bank, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) approved the hold by a narrow 4‑to‑3 vote. Committee members Paul Conway, Hayley Gourley and Karen Silk voted for a one‑point increase to 3.00%, while four members, including Governor Anna Breman and Prasanna Gai, voted to keep the rate unchanged.

Those advocating a pause argued that the current economic recovery is fragile, especially with weak household consumption and investment appetite, and that the risk of sudden shifts in the global geopolitical and economic environment has risen, warranting a wait‑and‑see approach.

RBNZ Governor Breman said, "In this meeting we felt it was appropriate to follow our prior communication stance, namely to keep the policy rate unchanged while continuing to signal that future meetings are very likely to see further hikes."

Addressing the impact of the dollar’s decline on inflation, Breman added, "When faced with inflationary pressure we would of course welcome a stronger NZD, but we have to weigh that against all other factors affecting medium‑ to long‑term inflation. We are therefore monitoring closely and carefully assessing its effect on future inflation."

However, the decision was met with strong criticism from market economists. Stephen Toplis, research head at Bank of New Zealand, said, "Frankly, we were shocked by the RBNZ’s decision to hold rates. While the bank is not obliged to follow market pricing or consensus, such a divergence is extremely rare. The move pushes an already weak NZD even lower, instantly amplifying inflation pressures."

Even though New Zealand’s September quarterly CPI annual growth slowed from 4.1% in the prior quarter to 3.7%, it remains above the bank’s 1%‑3% target range. The RBNZ stressed that if domestic price pressures do not ease effectively, future meetings could still see a return to tightening.

items.title: 〈台幣〉央行重申柳樹理論 量縮觀望升值3.4分收在32.418元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Reaffirms Willow‑Tree Theory, Reduced Volume, Cautious, Gains 3.4 cents to Close at 32.418
paras: 新台幣今(28)日量縮呈現小幅區間整理，終場收在32.418元，升值3.4分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值縮至17.03億美元。
新台幣今日以32.44元、升值1.2分開出後，一度貶至32.498元，盤中呈現升貶互見，午盤過後全面走升，最高見到32.398元，全日高低價差僅1角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元升逾0.1%，新台幣收升0.1%，人民幣處平盤左右，泰銖和星元貶0.05%左右，韓元則是重挫近1%。
中央銀行總裁楊金龍今日在立院備詢時強調，央行面對匯市一向採「柳樹理論」，讓匯率適度擺動，出現異常波動或失序時，基於維持金融穩定立場下會調節，以防波動過大。
統一投顧指出，中東外交出現轉機，油價回落，再加上 Meta 發行案獲 5 倍超額認購，帶動美股反彈，市場等待本周聯準會利率決策和CSP大廠財報，同時，台股短線負乖離大、技術指標落入超賣區，本周尚有聯發科、台達電、聯電等電子大廠法說會以及鴻海科技日等，有利於反彈。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed a modest range‑bound contraction today (28th), closing at 32.418 per US $, a gain of 3.4 cents, while transaction volume at a Taipei FX brokerage fell to $1.703 billion.

The dollar opened at 32.44, up 1.2 cents, then slipped to 32.498 before fluctuating intraday; after the lunch break it rallied steadily, touching a high of 32.398, with the day's high‑low spread limited to just one tenth of a unit.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen rose more than 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar gained 0.1%, the Chinese yuan stayed roughly flat, the Thai baht and Singapore dollar each fell about 0.05%, while the Korean won plunged nearly 1%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long emphasized in a legislative hearing that the bank always applies the “willow‑tree theory” to allow exchange rates to move moderately, and will intervene to maintain financial stability if abnormal or disorderly swings occur.

Unified Investment Research noted that a diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East and a pull‑back in oil prices, combined with Meta’s offering being oversubscribed five‑fold, sparked a rebound in US equities. Markets await this week’s Fed rate decision and major CSP earnings; meanwhile, Taiwan’s market shows a short‑term negative divergence and technical indicators in oversold territory, but upcoming earnings calls from MediaTek, Delta Electronics, UMC and Foxconn’s Tech Day could support a bounce.
